title: Bridging Brain Connectome and Clinical Notes: A Novel Multimodal Framework for MCI Study.
source: PubMed · IEEE transactions on medical imaging
zh_title: 脑连接组与临床笔记对齐的MCI多模态框架
summary: 提出将脑子网络作为token、在受试者与连接组层面把脑连接组与临床报告对齐到共享潜空间的多模态框架，用于轻度认知障碍研究。
key_points: 脑子网络作为token而非图像块

reason: 新颖多模态方法、MCI方向，但摘要无外部验证信息
abstract: [IEEE transactions on medical imaging] Integrating brain imaging data with clinical reports enables the effective use of complementary multimodal information, supporting more accurate and timely diagnosis in real-world clinical settings. This approach has gained growing attention in brain disorder research, yet significant limitations remain: how to encode brain structure and function to reflect meaningful neurological patterns, and how to effectively link objective imaging data with subjective text-based reports while establishing interpretable associations. In this work, we propose a novel multimodal framework that aligns brain connectomes with clinical reports in a shared cross-modal latent space at both subject and connectome levels. Our key innovation lies in treating brain subnetworks as tokens rather than raw image patches, enabling more efficient identification of system-level associations between neuroimaging findings and clinical observations. These cross-modal associations are further fused to enhance mild cognitive impairment (MCI) prediction and provide interpretable diagnostic insights. To our knowledge, this is the first attempt to integrate both structural and functional brain connectivity with non-imaging clinical information. Experimental validation on the ADNI dataset demonstrates performance competitive with recently reported methods. Notably, despite no explicit connectome-token-level supervision, the learned connectome-text associations recover multiple relationships independently reported in the neuroimaging and clinical literature, suggesting that the framework captures clinically coherent cross-modal associations. This pioneering work advances multimodal artificial intelligence (AI) for neurodegenerative disease diagnosis by bridging the gap between neuroimaging analysis and clinical text interpretation through innovative connectome tokenization and cross-modal alignment strategies.
zh_abstract: [IEEE医学影像汇刊] 将脑影像数据与临床报告相结合，可有效利用互补的多模态信息，在真实临床环境中支持更准确、更及时的诊断。该方法在脑部疾病研究中日益受到关注，但仍存在显著局限：如何对脑结构与功能进行编码以反映有意义的神经学模式，以及如何将客观的影像数据与主观的文本报告有效关联并建立可解释的关联。在本研究中，我们提出了一种新颖的多模态框架，在受试者和连接组两个层面，将脑连接组与临床报告对齐到共享的跨模态潜在空间中。我们的关键创新在于将脑子网络而非原始图像块视为token，从而能更高效地识别神经影像发现与临床观察之间的系统级关联。这些跨模态关联进一步被融合，以增强轻度认知障碍（MCI）的预测并提供可解释的诊断见解。据我们所知，这是首次尝试将脑结构连接和功能连接与非影像临床信息相整合。在ADNI数据集上的实验验证表明，其性能与近期报道的方法相当。值得注意的是，尽管没有显式的连接组token级监督，所学习到的连接组-文本关联仍还原出神经影像与临床文献中独立报道的多种关系，提示该框架捕捉到了临床上一致的跨模态关联。这项开创性工作通过创新的连接组token化和跨模态对齐策略，弥合了神经影像分析与临床文本解读之间的差距，推动了用于神经退行性疾病诊断的多模态人工智能（AI）的发展。

abstract: Recent evidence underscores the need for early post-surgical cavity delineation to improve brain tumor treatment. Manual segmentation—the gold standard—is slow and labor-intensive but necessary to link early post-surgical lesions to brain connectivity and functional outcome. Using one of the largest post-operative glioma MRI datasets available to date (N = 1056), (i) we evaluated the effect of postoperative scan timing on AI-based resection-cavity segmentation; (ii) we investigated whether automated segmentations replicate findings showing that surgery-induced network disconnection severity predicts worse language fluency scores. While the segmentation of chronic cavities yielded accurate results, early postoperative segmentations initially posed challenges due to domain shift. Semi-supervised learning and model fine-tuning overcame this issue, providing preliminary evidence supporting the adoption of AI-driven disconnectomics. We provide a robust AI-driven tool for early postsurgical assessment and functional recovery prediction in neuro-oncological care, showing that the time between surgery and cavity delineation is critical for AI reliability.
zh_abstract: 近期证据强调，为改善脑肿瘤治疗，需要在术后早期对手术残腔进行勾画。人工分割是金标准，但耗时且费力，却是将术后早期病灶与脑连接性及功能结局相联系所必需的。我们利用迄今可获得的最大规模术后胶质瘤MRI数据集之一（N = 1056），（i）评估了术后扫描时间对基于AI的切除腔分割的影响；（ii）探讨自动分割能否重复既往研究发现，即手术所致网络断连的严重程度可预测更差的语言流畅性评分。慢性期残腔的分割结果准确，而术后早期的分割最初因域偏移而面临挑战。半监督学习和模型微调克服了这一问题，为采用AI驱动的断连组学（disconnectomics）提供了初步证据支持。我们提供了一种稳健的AI驱动工具，用于神经肿瘤诊疗中的术后早期评估和功能恢复预测，并表明手术与残腔勾画之间的时间间隔对AI的可靠性至关重要。

abstract: [IEEE transactions on bio-medical engineering] To develop and validate InterGenEHR+, an interactive framework for natural language-conditioned generation of synthetic tabular data and longitudinal EHR trajectories for critically ill patients requiring mechanical ventilation and venovenous extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (VV-ECMO), enabling scenario-based evaluation of machine learning models in high-risk cohorts. InterGenEHR+ uses an optional large language model (LLM) parser for text-driven input. For single-time-point generation, we integrate variational autoencoders (VAEs) and diffusion models conditioned on observed variables. Multiple diffusion architectures support conditional longitudinal generation. The framework is evaluated on a multi-institutional VV-ECMO cohort of 874 patients using distributional fidelity metrics, imputation accuracy, adherence to clinical constraints, downstream mortality prediction tasks, and clinician evaluation. Gemma 3 4B with few-shot prompting achieves the best performance in parsing clinician prompts while maintaining a low spurious slot rate. The experimental results demonstrate strengths across IGE variants: IGE-TabDDPM and IGE-PMVAE show strong performance in single-time-point generation, whereas IGE-CSDI, IGE-FGTI, and IGE-MTSCI achieve the best performance on different longitudinal fidelity metrics. In downstream evaluations across five random seeds and three classifiers, models trained on synthetic cohorts retain predictive utility for mortality prediction on real test data. Clinician ratings further indicate that the generated trajectories are clinically plausible and consistent with the requested scenarios. InterGenEHR+ enables clinician-specified conditional generation of clinically coherent EHR trajectories with strong statistical fidelity and downstream predictive utility in the evaluated VV-ECMO cohort and could be extended to other clinical settings. This framework supports the development and evaluation of machine learning systems in data-sparse critical care settings and advances clinically grounded synthetic data generation for biomedical research.1.

abstract: [Therapeutic drug monitoring] Therapeutic drug monitoring (TDM) enables individualized pharmacotherapy for drugs with high interpatient variability and concentration-dependent effects. Conventional Bayesian approaches, although clinically established, may not fully capture pharmacokinetic complexity in dynamic or heterogeneous patient populations. Artificial intelligence (AI) and machine-learning methods offer complementary capabilities, including modeling nonlinear relationships and integrating high-dimensional clinical data. Peer-reviewed studies that applied AI or machine-learning methods to TDM between January 2017 and April 2026 were reviewed in accordance with Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses 2020 guidelines. Studies involving adult and pediatric populations were included, whereas reviews, editorials, and animal studies were excluded. Forty-seven studies covering a range of drugs, including vancomycin, tacrolimus, antiepileptics, mycophenolic acid, methotrexate, and voriconazole, were included. Tree-based ensemble methods, particularly eXtreme Gradient Boosting, random forest, and gradient boosting, were the most frequently applied algorithms. In general, these methods demonstrated strong predictive performance, with area under the receiver operating characteristic curve values up to 0.90 for classification tasks and coefficient of determination values up to 0.85 for regression tasks. In 13 studies, AI models demonstrated predictive performance comparable with or exceeding that of traditional population pharmacokinetic and Bayesian approaches for selected applications. However, these comparisons were heterogeneous and often based on retrospective data sets with limited external validation. AI-based methods have considerable potential for enhancing TDM, particularly for dose optimization, drug-exposure estimation, and toxicity prediction. However, evidence linking improved predictive performance to meaningful clinical outcomes remains limited.
zh_abstract: [治疗药物监测（Therapeutic Drug Monitoring）] 治疗药物监测（TDM）可对患者间变异度高且效应依赖浓度的药物实现个体化药物治疗。传统贝叶斯方法虽已在临床中确立，但可能无法完全捕捉动态或异质性患者人群中药代动力学的复杂性。人工智能（AI）和机器学习方法提供了互补的能力，包括建模非线性关系和整合高维临床数据。本研究依据《系统评价和荟萃分析优先报告条目》（PRISMA）2020 指南，对 2017 年 1 月至 2026 年 4 月间将 AI 或机器学习方法应用于 TDM 的同行评审研究进行了综述。纳入涉及成人和儿科人群的研究，排除综述、社论和动物研究。共纳入 47 项研究，涵盖多种药物，包括万古霉素、他克莫司、抗癫痫药、霉酚酸、甲氨蝶呤和伏立康唑。基于树的集成方法，尤其是极端梯度提升（eXtreme Gradient Boosting）、随机森林和梯度提升，是最常用的算法。总体而言，这些方法表现出较强的预测性能，分类任务的受试者工作特征曲线下面积最高可达 0.90，回归任务的决定系数最高可达 0.85。在 13 项研究中，AI 模型在特定应用中的预测性能与传统群体药代动力学和贝叶斯方法相当或更优。然而，这些比较存在异质性，且往往基于外部验证有限的回顾性数据集。基于 AI 的方法在增强 TDM 方面具有相当大的潜力，尤其是在剂量优化、药物暴露估计和毒性预测方面。然而，将预测性能的提升与有意义的临床结局相联系的证据仍然有限。

title: Multimodal deep learning approach for frailty classification using electrocardiogram and chest X-ray imaging.

summary: 回顾性分析 2,830 名老年人，构建融合胸片与心电图的多模态深度学习模型用于衰弱分类。

abstract: [PLOS digital health] Frailty is a critical age-related syndrome associated with increased risks of disability, hospitalization, and mortality. While Comprehensive Geriatric Assessment (CGA) is the standard for evaluation, it is often subjective, time-consuming, and resource-intensive. To address these limitations, this study developed and validated a multimodal deep learning framework that integrates chest X-rays (CXR) and electrocardiograms (ECG) to provide an objective and rapid tool for frailty classification. We retrospectively analyzed data from 2,830 older adults who underwent CGA between 2007 and 2024, partitioned chronologically into training, validation, and test sets. Frailty was defined using a Multidimensional Frailty Score (MFS) > 5. Three deep learning models were trained and evaluated: a CXR-only model (EVA-X vision transformer), an ECG-only model (DenseNet-121), and a multimodal model combining both inputs. The multimodal model outperformed the single-modality models and four non-imaging clinical baseline models incorporating age, sex, comorbidity index, or routine laboratory variables, achieving the highest area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.778 and area under the precision-recall curve (AUPRC) of 0.726. For continuous MFS estimation, the multimodal model achieved the highest Pearson correlation (r = 0.610) and the lowest mean absolute error (MAE = 1.68) among the evaluated models. Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM) was used to qualitatively explore the image regions that influenced model predictions. This multimodal AI framework demonstrates modest classification performance and feasibility for frailty screening. By leveraging routinely collected clinical images, this framework may serve as a practical screening adjunct to identify older adults who may benefit from formal CGA. Further studies are needed to determine its clinical utility when applied preoperatively for the stratification of postoperative risk.

title: Development of a deep learning model to automatically localize anatomic landmarks important for intraperitoneal free fluid detection during focused assessment with sonography in trauma (FAST).

abstract: [PloS one] The Focused Assessment with Sonography in Trauma (FAST) exam allows clinicians to rapidly identify intraperitoneal free fluid (FF), which can accumulate in several discrete anatomic locations. These locations represent potential spaces and are defined by adjacent key organ features. Satisfactory evaluation of these organ features is necessary to obtain a complete FAST exam. We sought to develop an algorithm that accurately identified relevant organs important for the FAST exam. Data was used from 218 prospectively enrolled subjects with positive and negative FAST exams yielding 2,218 videos and 323,304 frames. Images were frame annotated for the presence of the following key organ features: liver, caudal liver tip, spleen, caudal spleen tip, kidney, diaphragm, and bladder. Data were randomly split into training, validation, and test sets in a 6:2:2 ratio for training a deep learning model using the YOLOv5 object detection algorithm. Diagnostic accuracy of the test set is reported at the frame and video levels. At the frame level, the mean average precision (mAP50) was 0.71. At the video level, the mean F1 score for organ detection was 0.85. Video level detection of anatomic locations (defined by the co-incidence of two relevant organ structures) of potential FF accumulation showed a mean F1 of 0.79. At the video level, the model was optimized to favor a higher mean specificity (0.90, 95% CI 0.89-0.92) at the expense of a slightly reduced mean sensitivity (0.88, 95% CI 0.85-0.90). The inference speed was 26 ms per frame (38 frames per second) on a mobile tablet. This organ detection algorithm identifies the key organ features and their interfaces, which are important for FF assessment. The algorithm has a low inference speed that approximates real time temporal resolution, providing a foundation for future work supporting automated image capture and quality assessment.

abstract: [Biomedicine & pharmacotherapy = Biomedecine & pharmacotherapie] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly used in cardiovascular research where conventional analysis struggles with scale, heterogeneity, and multimodal integration. Its contribution differs across imaging, computational omics, mechanistic simulation, and drug discovery. This narrative review examines substantive applications of machine learning and deep learning while distinguishing them from routine bioinformatics and purely biophysical modeling. We assess independent biological units, validation strategies, and strength of inference in representative studies. Deep-learning imaging systems can provide reproducible quantitative phenotypes, but workflow performance alone does not establish mechanism. In single-cell and spatial studies, clustering, integration, trajectory inference, and network reconstruction generally yield associations or hypotheses unless experimentally supported. Mechanistic interpretation is bounded by the specific effect established through targeted perturbation or rescue with functional testing; lineage tracing and orthogonal readouts provide complementary support, not standalone proof of causation. Hybrid AI-biophysical models may accelerate personalized simulation, whereas heart-on-chip, engineered tissue, and organoid systems without learned components are validation platforms rather than AI methods. In drug discovery, active learning and molecular redesign can prioritize candidates, but predicted reductions in ion-channel liability do not demonstrate biological safety or reduced proarrhythmic risk. Major limitations include pseudoreplication, data leakage, domain shift, batch effects, uncertain labels, few independent hearts, demographic imbalance, incomplete calibration, and limited transfer among animal, iPSC-derived, and adult human systems. AI is most valuable when it produces robust phenotypes or experimentally testable hypotheses within a transparent validation framework, rather than when predictive accuracy is treated as mechanistic evidence.

abstract: [Science advances] Whether language and mathematics rely on shared or distinct neural representations remains unresolved in cognitive neuroscience. Here, we combined latent features from a large language model with functional magnetic resonance imaging encoding models to test cross-domain generalization in 32 participants performing sentence comprehension and calculation tasks. Cross-domain prediction identified cortical regions showing partially shared representations, most consistently in the left area 55b, while control analyses suggested that these effects could not be fully explained by low-level visual or task-general factors. Domain-specificity contrasts revealed stronger language-related prediction in the left superior temporal sulcus and angular gyrus and math-related prediction in the left precentral sulcus and bilateral intraparietal sulci. Model-weight analyses revealed distinct weight profiles associated with shared and domain-specific prediction patterns. Cross-domain regions also exhibited task-dependent functional coupling with language- and math-related networks. Together, these findings suggest that language and mathematics involve partially shared neural representations alongside domain-specific cortical organization, helping reconcile previous contrasting views on their neural basis.
zh_abstract: [Science advances] 语言和数学依赖共享的还是不同的神经表征，在认知神经科学中仍未解决。本研究将大语言模型的潜在特征与功能磁共振成像编码模型相结合，在32名执行句子理解和计算任务的参与者中检验跨领域泛化。跨领域预测识别出表现出部分共享表征的皮层区域，其中以左侧55b区最为一致；对照分析提示，这些效应不能完全由低水平视觉因素或任务普遍性因素解释。领域特异性对比显示，左侧颞上沟和角回的语言相关预测更强，左侧中央前沟和双侧顶内沟的数学相关预测更强。模型权重分析显示，共享预测模式与领域特异性预测模式对应不同的权重特征。跨领域区域还表现出与语言相关网络和数学相关网络之间依赖任务的功能耦合。总体而言，这些发现提示，语言和数学既涉及部分共享的神经表征，也存在领域特异性的皮层组织，有助于调和以往关于其神经基础的相互对立的观点。

abstract: Segmentation foundation models offer reusable tools for universal medical-image segmentation, but their development and evaluation have largely centered on structural CT and MRI imaging. Functional imaging such as PET provides complementary metabolic information yet remains less studied and validated. Moreover, existing evaluations often involve different datasets and tasks, making modality-associated variation difficult to distinguish from differences in segmentation targets and data distributions. To enable a more direct comparison, we introduce UMD, a whole-body multi-organ dataset comprising 490 PET/CT and 464 PET/MRI examinations with 13 annotated organs (approximately 675,000 2D slices and 12,000 3D organ annotations). abstract: Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs) show promise in medical applications, but their inability to faithfully ground responses in visual evidence raises serious concerns about clinical trustworthiness. abstract: Automating experiments does not necessarily advance scientific understanding. abstract: Evaluating general-purpose multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for surgical scene understanding remains limited due to scarce surgical data and fragmented evaluation protocols. We address these challenges through a two-stage evaluation framework for surgical scene understanding. In Stage I, we introduce SurgKnowBench, a diagnostic benchmark that harmonizes public surgical datasets across procedures and tasks and evaluates proprietary and open-source MLLMs to map the boundary of pretrained surgical competence. SurgKnowBench reveals that current models retain partial visual priors but remain weak on relational and procedural understanding and workflow assessment. title: Artificial intelligence aids multi-omics data integration in cancer drug discovery and development: from targets to drug synergy.

abstract: [Acta pharmacologica Sinica] The emergence of multi-omics technologies has enabled the integration of genomic, transcriptomic, epigenomic, proteomic, and metabolomic data to characterize the molecular complexity of cancer. Single-cell and spatial profiling further resolve intratumoral heterogeneity, cell-cell interactions, and the microenvironmental determinants of therapeutic responses. In parallel, artificial intelligence (AI) provides computational approaches for integrating these heterogeneous data types across target identification, drug response prediction, toxicity assessment, and drug-combination modeling. Across these domains, the available evidence indicates that multi-omics integration is most beneficial when the included layers provide complementary biological information; that single-cell and spatial omics analyses reveal treatment-resistant populations and niches but remain largely research-grade and thus not ready for routine clinical deployment; and that although foundation models support some representation-learning tasks, their advantages in perturbation-response prediction require confirmation via stringent evaluation. By distinguishing externally validated advances from retrospective proof-of-concept studies, we provide a practical framework for evaluating the translational readiness of AI-driven multi-omics tools in precision oncology.
zh_abstract: [Acta pharmacologica Sinica] 多组学技术的出现使得整合基因组、转录组、表观基因组、蛋白质组和代谢组数据以刻画癌症的分子复杂性成为可能。单细胞和空间分析进一步解析了肿瘤内异质性、细胞间相互作用以及决定治疗反应的微环境因素。与此同时，人工智能（AI）提供了计算方法，可在靶点识别、药物反应预测、毒性评估和药物联合建模等方面整合这些异质性数据类型。在上述各领域，现有证据表明：当所纳入的各组学层面提供互补的生物学信息时，多组学整合的获益最大；单细胞和空间组学分析可揭示耐药细胞群体和生态位，但在很大程度上仍属研究级别，因此尚未准备好用于常规临床应用；此外，尽管基础模型（foundation models）可支持部分表征学习任务，但其在扰动反应预测方面的优势仍需通过严格评估加以证实。通过区分经外部验证的进展与回顾性概念验证研究，我们提供了一个实用框架，用于评估AI驱动的多组学工具在精准肿瘤学中的转化成熟度。

abstract: Text prompted 3D computed tomography (CT) segmentation requires both full slice context and fine boundary precision across volumes where over $80\%$ of organ prompted slices lack the queried target. Existing medical vision language models (VLMs) are largely non native segmenters: they delegate pixel delineation outside the VLM by compressing reasoning into a 1D [SEG] vector for an external Segment Anything Model (SAM) decoder, quantizing masks into lossy discrete codebooks, or issuing box prompts to stateless external SAM tools without empty slice screening or spatial state memory. We introduce NativeSeg, a native vision language segmentation framework on Low Rank Adaptation (LoRA) adapted Qwen3.8-27B that performs dense mask decoding, volumetric triage, spatial error self diagnosis, and multiround local zoom directly over the VLM's 2D spatial visual tokens without external SAM decoders. NativeSeg decodes confidence maps from upper layer 2D spatial tokens fused with a five slice U-Net pathway, halts at zero zooms on $>91\%$ of standalone evaluations via a native presence gate ( ), localizes uncertain boundaries via a 20 cell multiscale error gate ( ), and accepts zoomed updates only when predicted error decreases. Trained solely on adult CT, NativeSeg improves Round $0$ DSC by $+19.81$ and $+7.04$ points over discrete codebook and 1D [SEG] readouts on the identical backbone, reaches $86.81\%$ adult and $87.04\%$ zero shot pediatric DSC, and safely refines 2D nnU-Net ($89.52\%$ adult; $86.86\%$ pediatric), 3D SegVol ($86.81\%$), and 3D VoxTell ($89.85\%$).

title: The Effectiveness and Durability of Pretraining Data Filtering in Protein Language Models
zh_title: 蛋白语言模型预训练数据过滤的有效性与持久性
summary: 以ESM-2系列研究过滤病毒蛋白的预训练安全措施：削弱病毒蛋白性能，但用少量病毒序列微调即可恢复。
key_points: 过滤降低病毒蛋白上的预测表现，非病毒基本保留
模型从8M到3B，过滤效果更强
微调恢复性能，最大模型约需80美元H100算力
reason: 蛋白基础模型安全性研究，结论有价值，预印本
abstract: Pretraining filtering is one of the most common safeguards for open-weight language models. Here we study its effectiveness, durability and scalability using the ESM-2 family of protein language models. We find that filtering viral proteins from the pretraining data meaningfully degrades masked language modelling, mutation effect prediction and long-range contact prediction on viral proteins, while largely preserving performance on non-viral proteins. These effects are concentrated among proteins from human-infecting viruses, and grow as we scale models from 8M to 3B parameters. As models increase in size, we find that stringent filtering becomes more effective. However, fine-tuning on sequences from the removed viral families restores the lost performance. Although the cost to recover performance increases with model scale, even for the largest models it costs about 80 USD of H100 time.
zh_abstract: 预训练过滤是开放权重语言模型最常见的防护措施之一。本文利用 ESM-2 蛋白质语言模型家族研究其有效性、持久性和可扩展性。我们发现，从预训练数据中过滤病毒蛋白会显著降低模型在病毒蛋白上的掩码语言建模、突变效应预测和长程接触预测性能，而对非病毒蛋白的性能基本保持不变。这些效应集中在感染人类的病毒蛋白上，并且随着模型规模从 8M 扩大到 3B 参数而增强。随着模型增大，我们发现严格过滤变得更加有效。然而，在被移除病毒家族的序列上进行微调即可恢复损失的性能。尽管恢复性能的成本随模型规模增加，但即使对最大的模型，也只需约 80 美元的 H100 算力费用。

title: MitoWorld: A Stochastic World Model of the Single-Cell Cycle under Genetic Perturbation
zh_title: MitoWorld：基因扰动下单细胞周期的随机世界模型
summary: 提出随机世界模型，联合生成扰动后单细胞外观演化与分裂时间，并在MitoCheck轨迹上评估。
key_points: 高斯潜空间连续演化加分裂风险函数
条件扩散渲染器生成图像
在17种敲低加对照的325条留出轨迹测试
reason: 生物医学世界模型新方法，预印本且数据有限；命中偏好上调
abstract: A cell observed after a gene knockdown has an uncertain future, both in how its appearance will evolve and when it will divide. Existing approaches predict endpoints or population-level changes without jointly modeling individual trajectories and division timing. In this work, we present MitoWorld, a stochastic world model that generates these future appearances as continuous evolution in a Gaussian reference latent, terminated by a division hazard and converted into images by a conditional diffusion renderer. The ordinary transition provably preserves its Gaussian reference, tying its noise to its dynamics; paired observations identify its discrete transition where stationary marginals cannot. zh_abstract: 在基因敲低后被观察的细胞，其未来具有不确定性，既体现在其外观将如何演变，也体现在其何时分裂。现有方法预测的是终点或群体水平的变化，而没有对个体轨迹和分裂时间进行联合建模。在这项工作中，我们提出了 MitoWorld，一种随机世界模型：它在高斯参考潜空间中将这些未来外观生成为连续演化过程，由分裂风险（division hazard）终止，并通过条件扩散渲染器转换为图像。可证明，普通转移过程保持其高斯参考分布，从而将其噪声与动力学联系起来；在平稳边缘分布无法做到的情形下，配对观测可以识别其离散转移。分裂风险将分裂时间转化为可与真实细胞周期长度进行检验的生存似然。在涵盖 17 种基因敲低和一个对照的 325 条留出 MitoCheck 轨迹上，MitoWorld 降低了 F……

title: ADSMoE: A mixture-of-experts-based transformer autoencoder for discovering multimodal Alzheimer's disease subtypes
zh_title: ADSMoE：用于发现多模态阿尔茨海默病亚型的MoE Transformer自编码器
summary: 预印本提出基于混合专家的多模态表示学习框架，可处理模态缺失，利用三个独立队列5,422名参与者识别AD潜在亚型。
key_points: Fleximodal MoE编码器适配任意模态组合
亚型特异MoE解码器
三个独立队列共5,422人
reason: 预印本，多队列多模态AD亚型，方向契合；证据有限
abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) exhibits substantial biological and clinical heterogeneity, posing critical challenges for advancing precision medicine. Existing data-driven approaches often rely on modality-specific clustering or predefined biomarker trajectories, limiting their ability to discover disease subtypes from incomplete, heterogeneous real-world data. In this study, we introduce ADSMoE, a mixture-of-experts (MoE)-based multimodal representation learning framework that jointly identifies AD subtypes as latent disease signatures while accommodating incomplete modality combinations. ADSMoE integrates a Fleximodal MoE encoder that accommodates arbitrary combinations of available modalities with a novel subtype-specific MoE decoder to capture complementary disease characteristics through expert specialization. Using data from 5,422 participants across three independent cohorts, we trained ADSMoE on the ADNI cohort and externally validated the identified subtypes in NACC and UKB without model retraining. The proposed ADSMoE identified four AD subtypes with distinct neuroimaging patterns, genetic and proteomic associations, and clinical characteristics. Benchmarking analyses demonstrated robust subtype discovery and strong biological and clinical relevance, while external validation revealed consistent subtype-associated characteristics across independent cohorts. ADSMoE advances AD subtyping by uncovering biologically and clinically meaningful AD heterogeneity from incomplete multimodal data, providing a scalable framework for disease stratification, biomarker discovery, and future precision medicine applications in AD.
zh_abstract: 阿尔茨海默病（AD）具有显著的生物学和临床异质性，对推进精准医学构成了严峻挑战。现有的数据驱动方法往往依赖于特定模态的聚类或预先定义的生物标志物轨迹，限制了其从不完整、异质的真实世界数据中发现疾病亚型的能力。在本研究中，我们提出了 ADSMoE，这是一种基于专家混合（MoE）的多模态表征学习框架，可在适应不完整模态组合的同时，将AD亚型作为潜在疾病特征联合识别出来。ADSMoE 整合了可适应任意可用模态组合的 Fleximodal MoE 编码器，以及一种新型的亚型特异性 MoE 解码器，通过专家专门化来捕捉互补的疾病特征。我们利用来自三个独立队列的5,422名参与者的数据，在 ADNI 队列上训练 ADSMoE，并在 NACC 和 UKB 中对所识别的亚型进行外部验证，无需重新训练模型。ADSMoE 识别出四种AD亚型，它们具有不同的神经影像模式、遗传和蛋白质组学关联以及临床特征。基准分析显示其亚型发现稳健，并具有较强的生物学和临床相关性，而外部验证显示各独立队列中与亚型相关的特征一致。ADSMoE 通过从不完整的多模态数据中揭示具有生物学和临床意义的AD异质性，推进了AD亚型划分，为疾病分层、生物标志物发现以及未来AD精准医学应用提供了可扩展的框架。

title: Prospective prediction of clinical trial outcomes from public evidence
zh_title: 基于公开证据前瞻性预测临床试验结局
summary: TrialOutlook用GPT-5结合标准化证据档案预测试验是否达到主要终点；69项已裁定试验上AUC为0.819（预印本）。
key_points: 694项在研试验入组，69项结局已裁定
29项失败中正确识别27项
reason: 前瞻性设计的试验结局预测，但样本仅69例且为预印本
abstract: Predicting clinical trial outcomes requires interpreting biological and clinical evidence in the context of a specific intervention, population and study design. Here we test whether a general-purpose large language model (LLM) can predict trial outcomes from publicly available evidence. We introduce TrialDossier, which assembles standardized evidence dossiers, and TrialOutlook, which uses these dossiers with GPT-5 to estimate the probability that a trial meets its prespecified primary endpoint. Among 694 ongoing trials with results expected within six months of cohort assembly, 69 outcomes first disclosed after forecast recording had been adjudicated by 20 October 2026. TrialOutlook achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.819 (95% confidence interval, 0.708 to 0.914) and an average precision of 0.860. TrialOutlook correctly identified 27 of 29 failures (93.1%) and incorrectly classified 17 of 40 successes as failures. We further recorded forecasts for 5,809 ongoing trials associated with US-listed companies and established a public benchmark linking archived evidence and fixed forecasts to adjudicated outcomes as they become available.
zh_abstract: 预测临床试验结果需要结合特定干预措施、人群和研究设计来解读生物学和临床证据。在此，我们检验通用大语言模型（LLM）能否根据公开可得的证据预测试验结果。我们提出了TrialDossier（用于汇集标准化证据档案）和TrialOutlook（利用这些档案并借助GPT-5估计试验达到其预先设定主要终点的概率）。在队列组建后预计六个月内将公布结果的694项进行中试验中，有69项结果在预测记录之后首次披露，并已于2026年10月20日前完成裁定。TrialOutlook的受试者操作特征曲线下面积为0.819（95%置信区间，0.708至0.914），平均精确率为0.860。TrialOutlook正确识别了29项失败试验中的27项（93.1%），并将40项成功试验中的17项错误分类为失败。我们还记录了与美国上市公司相关的5,809项进行中试验的预测，并建立了一个公开基准，将存档证据和固定预测与随后可获得的已裁定结果相关联。

title: WakeSentry: real-time awakening detection from single-channel EEG across sleep cohorts and forehead headbands
zh_title: WakeSentry：基于单通道EEG的实时觉醒检测
summary: WakeSentry仅用过去额叶EEG实时检测睡眠觉醒，在5个PSG队列1,529晚及224晚头带数据上评估，灵敏度优于GSSC等（预印本）。
key_points: 5个队列留出测试，含头带设备
同等0.5次/小时假觉醒下灵敏度更高
PSG灵敏度由63.8%升至70.5%
reason: 多队列外部留出验证加头带数据，预印本，睡眠方向
abstract: Objective/Background: Awakenings after sleep onset are a core measure of sleep continuity, and EEG headbands and closed-loop stimulators, now used at home, must detect each one as it happens, to count it or to stop stimulation. Open sleep stagers match expert scorers, yet have been evaluated only offline over whole nights, so their real-time performance is untested. Patients/Methods: To fill this gap, we developed WakeSentry, which reads only past frontal EEG and learns the moment of waking through an awakening module. We tested it on 1,529 nights from five polysomnography (PSG) cohorts, three clinical, each held out of training, and on 224 headband nights, against GSSC, U-Sleep and YASA. Results: At a matched rate of 0.5 false awakenings per hour, WakeSentry caught more awakenings than GSSC in every cohort and on both headbands. On PSG its sensitivity rose from 63.8% to 70.5%, above U-Sleep and YASA on average. On the headbands it rose from 49.8% to 53.9%, a gain lost without the awakening module. With thresholds preset on the training cohorts, it still outperformed GSSC in six of seven test sets, with at most 0.40 false awakenings per hour. As a replayed stimulator gate, it shortened stimulation during wake in five test sets while staying open for at least 85% of N2 and N3. Conclusions: WakeSentry therefore works in patients and on unseen headbands. It can count awakenings at home and stop stimulation at each one, enabling multi-night monitoring of insomnia and closed-loop stimulation that stops when the sleeper wakes.
zh_abstract: 【目的/背景】睡眠起始后的觉醒是衡量睡眠连续性的核心指标，而目前已在家中使用的脑电（EEG）头带和闭环刺激器必须在每次觉醒发生时即时检测到它，以便计数或停止刺激。开源睡眠分期工具与专家评分者的水平相当，但仅在整夜离线条件下进行过评估，其实时性能尚未经过检验。【患者/方法】为填补这一空白，我们开发了 WakeSentry，它仅读取过去的额叶 EEG，并通过一个觉醒模块学习觉醒的时刻。我们在来自五个多导睡眠图（PSG）队列（其中三个为临床队列，每个队列均不参与训练）的 1,529 个夜晚以及 224 个头带夜晚上对其进行了测试，并与 GSSC、U-Sleep 和 YASA 比较。【结果】在匹配的每小时 0.5 次假觉醒率下，WakeSentry 在每个队列以及两种头带上检出的觉醒均多于 GSSC。在 PSG 上，其灵敏度由 63.8% 升至 70.5%，平均高于 U-Sleep 和 YASA。在头带上，其灵敏度由 49.8% 升至 53.9%，而去掉觉醒模块后这一增益消失。在训练队列上预设阈值的情况下，它在七个测试集中的六个仍优于 GSSC，假觉醒率最高为每小时 0.40 次。作为回放的刺激器门控，它在五个测试集中缩短了觉醒期间的刺激时间，同时在至少 85% 的 N2 和 N3 期保持开启。【结论】因此，WakeSentry 适用于患者以及未见过的头带。它可在家中对觉醒计数，并在每次觉醒时停止刺激，从而实现失眠的多夜监测以及在睡眠者醒来时停止的闭环刺激。

title: MedExAgent: Training LLM Agents to Ask, Examine, and Diagnose in Noisy Clinical Environments
zh_title: MedExAgent：在噪声临床环境中训练LLM智能体问诊、检查与诊断
summary: 将临床诊断形式化为含问诊、开具检查（工具调用）和下诊断三类动作的POMDP，训练LLM智能体应对不同患者画像与噪声信息。
key_points: 诊断建模为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程
动作包含问诊、检查工具调用、诊断
针对噪声与不完整信息的交互式环境
reason: 新颖的交互式诊断智能体训练方法，预印本
abstract: Real-world clinical diagnosis is a complex process in which the doctor is required to obtain information from both interaction with the patient and conducting medical exams. Additionally, the doctor needs to adapt to different patient personas, as well as noisy and incomplete information that can happen at any time during the process. However, existing benchmarks for medical LLMs and methods for automatic diagnosis largely simplify this process by reducing it to single-turn question answering, noise-free conversations, or sequential exam making, etc., ignoring the interactive and uncertain nature of clinical diagnosis. In this paper, we aim to address this gap by formalizing clinical diagnosis as a Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP) with three action types: questioning the patient, ordering medical exams as tool calls, and issuing a diagnosis. We also introduce a system
zh_abstract: 真实世界的临床诊断是一个复杂的过程，医生需要通过与患者的互动以及进行医学检查来获取信息。此外，医生还需要适应不同的患者特征，以及在过程中随时可能出现的噪声和不完整信息。然而，现有的医学大语言模型基准和自动诊断方法在很大程度上简化了这一过程，将其简化为单轮问答、无噪声对话或顺序检查等，忽视了临床诊断的交互性和不确定性。在本文中，我们旨在弥补这一不足，将临床诊断形式化为具有三类动作的部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）：向患者提问、以工具调用方式开具医学检查，以及给出诊断。我们还引入了一个系统

title: Why ML-based cough models do not generalize: a systematic cross-dataset evaluation for tuberculosis screening
zh_title: 咳嗽模型为何难泛化：结核筛查的跨数据集评估
summary: 在三个独立数据集上评估咳嗽结核分类器，内部AUC最高0.76，外部常低于0.6，模型更多学到设备与数据集特征。
key_points: 经典ML与深度学习均难以泛化
音频表征按设备和数据集聚类
临床变量基线泛化更稳定
reason: 多数据集外部评估揭示混杂偏差，有警示价值，预印本
abstract: Cough acoustics are promising for non-invasive tuberculosis (TB) screening, yet whether machine learning (ML) models capture disease-related acoustics or artifacts of data collection remains unresolved. We evaluated the cross-dataset generalizability of classical ML and deep learning (DL) cough-based TB classifiers across three independent datasets. Despite moderate within-dataset performance (ROC-AUC up to $0.76 \pm 0.06$), both pipelines fail to generalize, with external performance frequently below 0.6, indicating a possible limitation of the data. We further observed that audio representations are organized by recording device and dataset rather than TB status, predicted TB probability tracks country-level prevalence in CODA, and device mismatch degrades transfer while device-diverse training improves it. zh_abstract: 咳嗽声学特征在无创结核病（TB）筛查方面前景广阔，但机器学习（ML）模型捕获的究竟是疾病相关的声学特征，还是数据采集带来的伪影，仍未得到解决。我们在三个独立数据集上评估了基于咳嗽的经典 ML 和深度学习（DL）结核病分类器的跨数据集泛化能力。尽管数据集内性能中等（ROC-AUC 最高为 $0.76 \pm 0.06$），两种流程均无法泛化，外部性能常低于 0.6，提示数据本身可能存在局限。我们进一步观察到：音频表征是按录音设备和数据集而非结核病状态组织的；在 CODA 中，预测的结核病概率与国家层面的患病率一致；设备不匹配会降低迁移性能，而设备多样化的训练可改善迁移性能。此外，临床变量基线的泛化更为一致（ROC-A

title: A Subspecialty Diagnostic System Powered by Self-Supervised Learning for Cervical Histopathology
zh_title: 自监督学习驱动的宫颈组织病理亚专科诊断系统
summary: 提出CerS-Path，先用约1.9亿图像块自监督预训练，再用250万图文对多模态增强，并整合诊断功能。
key_points: 约1.9亿组织块自监督预训练
250万图文对多模态增强
面向宫颈病理亚专科任务
reason: 大规模亚专科病理基础模型，摘要无评测结果，预印本
abstract: Cervical cancer remains a major malignancy in women, with large-scale human papillomavirus-based screening generating a large volume of biopsies and, for advanced cases, surgical specimens, imposing an overwhelming diagnostic burden that necessitates precise histopathological evaluation. Although deep learning shows promise, general foundation models offer a broader reach but remain limited in capturing subspecialty-specific features and task adaptability. We introduce the Cervical Subspecialty Pathology (CerS-Path) diagnostic system, built upon the subspecialized dataset and developed through two synergistic pretraining stages: self-supervised learning on approximately 190 million tissue patches to build a cervical-specific feature extractor, and multimodal enhancement with 2.5 million image-text pairs, followed by diagnostic functions integration and downstream task enhancement. zh_abstract: 宫颈癌仍是女性的主要恶性肿瘤，基于人乳头瘤病毒的大规模筛查产生了大量活检标本，晚期病例还有手术标本，带来了沉重的诊断负担，因而需要精确的组织病理学评估。尽管深度学习前景可观，但通用基础模型覆盖面更广，却在捕捉亚专科特异性特征和任务适应性方面仍有局限。我们提出宫颈亚专科病理（Cervical Subspecialty Pathology，CerS-Path）诊断系统，其基于亚专科化数据集构建，并通过两个协同的预训练阶段开发：在约 1.9 亿个组织图块上进行自监督学习以构建宫颈特异性特征提取器，以及利用 250 万个图像-文本对进行多模态增强，随后进行诊断功能整合和下游任务增强。CerS-P

title: Diagnostic Accuracy and Navigation Behavior of Vision-Language Model Agents Reading Emergency CT and MRI Examinations
zh_title: 视觉语言模型智能体阅读急诊CT/MRI的诊断准确率与导航行为
summary: 回顾性评估6个VLM在100例急诊CT/MRI上的表现，自由导航准确率32.6%，一次性输入全部切片或关键切片约42%。
key_points: 4800次运行，四种探索条件
自由导航准确率最低(32.6%)
9名放射科医生读30例作对照
reason: VLM智能体与医生对照评估，回顾性且样本小，预印本
abstract: Purpose. To evaluate the diagnostic accuracy and image navigation behavior of vision-language model (VLM) agents under varying exploration strategies. Materials and Methods. In this retrospective study, six VLMs read 100 emergency CT and MRI examinations published in a public archive (March 2025-August 2026) under four conditions (free navigation, navigation from a key slice, and all slices or key slices in a single request), twice each (4800 runs). Nine radiologists read 30 of those cases. A large language model judge validated against two radiologists graded the answers. abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] Precision medicine relies heavily on electronic health records (EHRs) to systematically capture longitudinal clinical data across populations. Integrating omics data, such as genomics, proteomics, and metabolomics, with EHRs holds transformative potential for individual-level disease risk assessment and therapeutic optimization. Recent advances in artificial intelligence, particularly multimodal learning algorithms, have enabled deeper exploration of EHR data, enhancing predictive modeling, patient stratification, and phenotyping. These artificial intelligence (AI)-driven approaches are expanding the scope of precision medicine from research contexts to scalable, real-time clinical decision-making. In real-world implementation, however, leveraging EHRs for precision medicine demands navigating complex technical, ethical, and operational challenges. These include data interoperability, model generalizability, and equity concerns. Future efforts should emphasize standardization, responsible AI practices, and integration of digital health and patient-reported outcomes to build learning health systems that are adaptive, equitable, and clinically impactful.
zh_abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] 精准医学在很大程度上依赖电子健康记录（EHR）来系统性地获取人群的纵向临床数据。将基因组学、蛋白质组学和代谢组学等组学数据与EHR整合，在个体层面的疾病风险评估和治疗优化方面具有变革性潜力。人工智能的最新进展，特别是多模态学习算法，使得对EHR数据的更深入探索成为可能，从而增强了预测建模、患者分层和表型分析。这些由人工智能（AI）驱动的方法正在将精准医学的范围从研究场景扩展到可规模化、实时的临床决策。然而，在实际应用中，将EHR用于精准医学需要应对复杂的技术、伦理和运营方面的挑战，包括数据互操作性、模型泛化能力和公平性问题。未来的工作应着重于标准化、负责任的AI实践，以及数字健康和患者报告结局的整合，以构建具有适应性、公平性并能产生临床影响的学习型健康系统。

abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] As a crucial component in preclinical cancer research, patient-derived models (PDMs) are experiencing a substantial transformation due to AI integration. AI improves the conversion efficiency of PDMs' static-dynamic predictions through cross-modal data integration and supports a comprehensive precision medicine technology platform that encompasses everything from molecular mechanisms to clinical translation. In clinical translation, the "AI-PDMs" system is revolutionizing oncology drug development and enabling personalized treatment decisions, moving from experience-based methods to data-driven strategies. This paper provides a detailed summary of AI's innovative uses of PDMs, such as machine learning-based high-dimensional pharmacological sensitivity data mining, deep learning-enhanced 3D tumor microenvironment modeling, and computer vision-driven advancements in pathological feature annotation, thereby offering a systematic framework for future cancer diagnosis and treatment innovations.

abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] The inherent complexity and heterogeneity of cancer create an urgent need for individualized treatment strategies. However, traditional population-based medical approaches have limitations in addressing patient-specific differences. Meanwhile, conventional clinical trials are often constrained by lengthy timelines, high costs, and difficulties in patient recruitment, particularly for rare cancers and pediatric populations, thereby hindering the development of novel therapies. To address these challenges, medical digital twins (MDTs) have emerged as dynamic computational models that represent an individual patient's physiology and disease state and are continuously updated as real-world data accumulate. To explain how MDTs transform accumulating patient data into actionable insights, this chapter first introduces their fundamental architecture, comprising five interdependent components: the patient, data connection, patient-in-silico, interface, and twin synchronization. Within this architecture, the patient-in-silico component can be constructed using mechanistic models based on established biological principles, artificial intelligence models driven by large-scale clinical data, or hybrid models combining both approaches. Representative mechanistic and artificial intelligence-driven MDTs are then presented to illustrate how these modeling approaches have been applied in oncology. Specifically, MDTs can support precision oncology and improve the efficiency of clinical trials. In precision oncology, MDTs can simulate disease progression and therapeutic responses, allowing treatment regimens to be tested virtually before administration and thereby supporting personalized treatment decisions. In virtual clinical trials, MDTs can enhance randomized trials through the PROCOVA™ methodology, provide synthetic control arms for single-arm studies, and support the identification of optimal dosing regimens in early-phase trials. However, MDTs also face challenges related to computational complexity, generalizability across diverse populations, AI-related model validation and regulatory compliance, and underdeveloped ethical frameworks for continuous-learning systems. Despite these challenges, MDTs hold considerable potential to reshape cancer care, optimize individualized therapies, and accelerate oncology drug development.
zh_abstract: [分子生物学方法（Methods in Molecular Biology）] 癌症固有的复杂性和异质性使得个体化治疗策略的需求十分迫切。然而，传统基于人群的医疗方法在应对患者个体差异方面存在局限。与此同时，传统临床试验往往受限于周期长、成本高以及患者招募困难，尤其是在罕见癌症和儿科人群中，从而阻碍了新疗法的开发。为应对这些挑战，医学数字孪生（MDT）作为动态计算模型应运而生，它代表个体患者的生理和疾病状态，并随着真实世界数据的积累而持续更新。为说明 MDT 如何将不断积累的患者数据转化为可操作的见解，本章首先介绍其基本架构，包括五个相互依存的组成部分：患者、数据连接、患者虚拟体（patient-in-silico）、界面和孪生同步。在该架构中，患者虚拟体部分可以通过基于既定生物学原理的机制模型、由大规模临床数据驱动的人工智能模型，或结合两种方法的混合模型来构建。随后介绍了具有代表性的机制模型和人工智能驱动的 MDT，以说明这些建模方法在肿瘤学中的应用。具体而言，MDT 可支持精准肿瘤学并提高临床试验效率。在精准肿瘤学中，MDT 可模拟疾病进展和治疗反应，使治疗方案能在给药前进行虚拟测试，从而支持个性化治疗决策。在虚拟临床试验中，MDT 可通过 PROCOVA™ 方法增强随机试验，为单臂研究提供合成对照组，并支持在早期试验中确定最佳给药方案。然而，MDT 也面临诸多挑战，涉及计算复杂性、在不同人群中的泛化能力、AI 相关的模型验证与监管合规，以及针对持续学习系统的伦理框架尚不完善。尽管存在这些挑战，MDT 在重塑癌症诊疗、优化个体化治疗和加速肿瘤药物研发方面仍具有巨大潜力。

abstract: [European respiratory review : an official journal of the European Respiratory Society] Noninvasive ventilation (NIV) and high-flow nasal therapy (HFNT) are central to the management of acute and chronic respiratory failure, yet their monitoring remains largely descriptive and reactive. Artificial intelligence (AI) has the potential to transform this paradigm by enabling dynamic, predictive and individualised approaches to respiratory support. This narrative review summarises current knowledge and future perspectives of AI applications in NIV and HFNT monitoring. AI techniques, including supervised and unsupervised machine learning, deep learning, and hybrid approaches, can integrate multimodal data across different timescales, from high-frequency ventilator signals to longitudinal telemonitoring data. Current applications include early detection of treatment failure, outcome prediction, patient phenotyping and automated detection of patient-ventilator asynchrony. While these approaches have shown promising performance in retrospective and proof-of-concept studies, their implementation in routine clinical practice remains limited. Key challenges include data heterogeneity, limited sample sizes, insufficient external validation and issues related to interpretability and integration into clinical workflows. Regulatory and ethical considerations further highlight the need to ensure transparency, safety and clinician trust. Future developments are expected to move towards adaptive and closed-loop systems capable of continuously optimising respiratory support. Ultimately, AI should be viewed as a tool to augment clinical expertise, supporting a shift towards more anticipatory, personalised and responsive respiratory care.
zh_abstract: [欧洲呼吸综述：欧洲呼吸学会官方期刊] 无创通气（NIV）和高流量鼻导管治疗（HFNT）是急性和慢性呼吸衰竭管理的核心手段，但其监测在很大程度上仍停留在描述性和被动反应式的层面。人工智能（AI）有望通过实现动态、预测性和个体化的呼吸支持方式来改变这一模式。本叙述性综述总结了 AI 在 NIV 和 HFNT 监测中应用的现有知识和未来前景。包括监督和无监督机器学习、深度学习及混合方法在内的 AI 技术，可整合不同时间尺度的多模态数据，从高频呼吸机信号到纵向远程监测数据。目前的应用包括早期识别治疗失败、结局预测、患者表型分型以及自动检测人机不同步。尽管这些方法在回顾性研究和概念验证研究中表现出良好的性能，但其在常规临床实践中的应用仍然有限。主要挑战包括数据异质性、样本量有限、外部验证不足，以及可解释性和与临床工作流程整合方面的问题。监管和伦理方面的考量进一步凸显了确保透明度、安全性和临床医生信任的必要性。未来的发展预计将朝着能够持续优化呼吸支持的自适应和闭环系统方向迈进。最终，AI 应被视为增强临床专业能力的工具，推动呼吸诊疗向更具预见性、个体化和响应性的方向转变。

abstract: [Clinical nutrition ESPEN] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly being investigated as a tool for precision nutrition because it can analyse heterogeneous dietary, clinical, physiological, behavioural, and molecular data. This narrative review critically examines how machine learning, deep learning, computer vision, natural language processing, explainable AI, continuous glucose monitoring, wearable technologies, and multi-omics approaches may support individualized nutritional assessment and decision-making. Particular attention is given to the distinction between predictive research, digital personalized nutrition, AI-enabled clinical interventions, and commercial nutrition platforms. Current evidence shows that personalized digital nutrition can improve selected dietary behaviours, while observational AI and multi-omics studies can predict substantial inter-individual variation in metabolic responses. Importantly, evidence that an AI-enabled intervention improves clinical outcomes is still limited and is concentrated in selected settings, including a multicentre randomized trial of an AI-based dietary management platform in adults with type 2 diabetes. Emerging technologies such as large language models, digital twins, federated learning, and adaptive algorithms remain promising but require prospective clinical validation. Major barriers include data quality, algorithmic bias, privacy, interoperability, model transparency, regulatory uncertainty, and limited external validation. Future research should prioritize pragmatic multicentre randomized trials, transparent reporting of model performance, independent validation, health-economic evaluation, and clinically meaningful outcomes. AI should therefore be considered an adjunct to evidence-based nutritional care rather than a replacement for professional clinical judgement. The review differs from technology-centred and methodology-focused reviews by explicitly linking AI modalities and multi-omics data with evidence maturity, clinical trial findings, implementation barriers, and the level of inference justified for each technology.

summary: 综述 AI 如何通过传感器信号去噪与深度学习头部模型，改进轻度脑损伤的生物力学监测。
key_points: 可对护齿传感器信号去噪并识别真实撞击
可推断撞击方向、位置、速度和力
深度学习模型将头部运动映射为全脑应变
reason: 方法类综述，无原始验证数据，属增量档
abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] Mild traumatic brain injury (mTBI) is difficult to identify rapidly because clinical symptoms may be delayed and conventional CT or MRI often reveals no structural abnormalities. Biomechanics-based monitoring provides an objective complementary strategy by measuring head kinematics at the moment of impact and estimating the resulting brain deformation. This review summarizes how artificial intelligence (AI) can overcome two major barriers to this approach: errors in wearable-sensor measurements and the high computational cost of finite element head models. AI-based methods can denoise instrumented mouthguard signals, distinguish true impacts from false triggers, and infer impact direction, location, speed, and force. Deep learning head models can further map six-degree-of-freedom head kinematics to whole-brain strain and strain-rate distributions within milliseconds, enabling near-real-time tissue-level injury assessment. Recent advances, including kinematic feature optimization, principal component analysis, impact subtyping, transfer learning, unsupervised domain adaptation, and spatiotemporal prediction, have improved model efficiency, interpretability, and generalizability across impact scenarios. Integrating wearable sensing with AI-accelerated brain modeling could support rapid removal from exposure, earlier clinical evaluation and intervention, and monitoring of cumulative impact dose. Future research should improve sensor wearability and coupling, incorporate subject-specific brain morphology and cortical folding, represent cerebrospinal fluid mechanics more realistically, and develop unified models that jointly estimate brain deformation and predict clinically confirmed injury. AI-enabled biomechanical monitoring may therefore complement symptom- and imaging-based assessments and advance real-time, personalized mTBI detection and prevention.
zh_abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] 轻度创伤性脑损伤（mTBI）难以被快速识别，因为临床症状可能延迟出现，而且常规 CT 或 MRI 往往未见结构异常。基于生物力学的监测通过测量撞击瞬间的头部运动学并估算由此产生的脑变形，提供了一种客观的补充策略。本综述总结了人工智能（AI）如何克服这一方法的两大障碍：可穿戴传感器测量的误差，以及有限元头部模型的高计算成本。基于 AI 的方法可以对仪器化护齿（instrumented mouthguard）信号去噪，区分真实撞击与误触发，并推断撞击的方向、位置、速度和力。深度学习头部模型还可以在数毫秒内将六自由度头部运动学映射为全脑应变和应变率分布，从而实现近实时的组织水平损伤评估。近期的进展，包括运动学特征优化、主成分分析、撞击亚型划分、迁移学习、无监督域适应和时空预测，提高了模型在不同撞击场景下的效率、可解释性和泛化能力。将可穿戴传感与 AI 加速的脑模型相结合，可支持迅速使受伤者脱离暴露、更早进行临床评估和干预，并监测累积撞击剂量。未来研究应改进传感器的佩戴舒适性和耦合性，纳入个体特异性的脑形态和皮质折叠，更真实地呈现脑脊液力学，并建立能够同时估算脑变形并预测经临床确认的损伤的统一模型。因此，AI 赋能的生物力学监测可能补充基于症状和影像的评估，并推进 mTBI 的实时、个性化检测与预防。

title: Deep Learning Assisted Label-Free Microscopy for Cell Death Analysis in Real-Time.
zh_title: 深度学习辅助无标记显微镜实时分析细胞死亡机制
summary: 提出多模态时空深度学习框架，基于相差与暗场延时显微视频对BT-20乳腺癌细胞的死亡机制进行分类。
key_points: 训练3D卷积、卷积-循环、迁移学习和Transformer模型
综合各架构与模态，平衡准确率达0.98
无需昂贵试剂与复杂样本处理
reason: 单一细胞系体外研究，无外部验证，属增量档
abstract: [Journal of biophotonics] Cytotoxicity assessment is fundamental to many areas of biomedical research, yet cell viability assays alone do not reveal death mechanisms, for example, apoptosis and necrosis. Conventional endpoint assays, including Western blotting, ELISA, and fluorescence microscopy/cytometry, require costly reagents, extensive sample preparation, and specialized expertise, limiting accessibility and scalability. Here, we present a multimodal spatiotemporal deep learning framework for classifying cell death mechanisms from phase-contrast and dark-field microscopy. Time-lapse videos of drug-treated BT-20 breast cancer cells were recorded in both modalities. These cells were used to train 3D convolutional, convolutional-recurrent, transfer-learning, and transformer models. Combined across architectures and modalities, the models achieved a balanced accuracy of 0.98 on recordings not used for training. The CytoMorpheus Analyzer runs the full pipeline from raw microscopy data, classifying over a thousand cells within minutes. These results highlight the potential of label-free microscopy with deep learning for real-time, high-throughput profiling of cell death and drug response.
zh_abstract: [Journal of biophotonics] 细胞毒性评估是许多生物医学研究领域的基础，但仅靠细胞活力检测无法揭示细胞死亡机制，例如凋亡和坏死。包括 Western blot、ELISA 以及荧光显微镜/细胞术在内的传统终点检测需要昂贵的试剂、繁琐的样本制备和专业技术，限制了其可及性和可扩展性。在此，我们提出一种多模态时空深度学习框架，用于基于相差显微镜和暗场显微镜对细胞死亡机制进行分类。我们以两种模态记录了经药物处理的 BT-20 乳腺癌细胞的延时视频，并用这些细胞训练了 3D 卷积、卷积-循环、迁移学习和 Transformer 模型。综合各架构和模态，这些模型在未用于训练的记录上取得了 0.98 的平衡准确率。CytoMorpheus Analyzer 可从原始显微镜数据运行完整流程，在数分钟内对一千多个细胞进行分类。这些结果凸显了无标记显微镜结合深度学习在细胞死亡和药物反应的实时、高通量分析中的潜力。

title: AI-empowered lipidomics advances metabolic research.
source: PubMed · Trends in endocrinology and metabolism: TEM
zh_title: AI赋能脂质组学推动代谢研究
summary: 综述AI与脂质组学、质谱成像及脂质代谢通量组学结合的进展，并评估计算结果的可信度。
key_points: AI加速时空数据处理，解析脂质代谢异质性
可辅助识别候选生物标志物并提出假设
考察注释置信度、定量准确性与跨平台重现性
reason: 综述类文章，信息偏概括，属增量档
abstract: [Trends in endocrinology and metabolism: TEM] The complex structures and dynamic processes of lipids make it challenging to decipher lipid reprogramming in metabolic diseases. Integrating artificial intelligence (AI) with lipidomics, mass spectrometry imaging, and lipid metabolic fluxomics enables rapid, high-precision, and in-depth spatiotemporal profiling of lipid species. In this review, we summarize advances in AI-empowered lipidomics, which not only accelerate spatiotemporal data processing but also offer new avenues to resolve the heterogeneity of lipid metabolism. Importantly, AI-assisted lipidomics could identify candidate biomarkers and generate testable hypotheses about disease mechanisms. Furthermore, we evaluate whether computational advances yield trustworthy evidence by examining annotation confidence, quantitative accuracy, cross-platform reproducibility, uncertainty calibration, and external validation. We also address the current limitations of AI-assisted lipidomics, particularly the risk of AI hallucinations.
zh_abstract: [Trends in endocrinology and metabolism: TEM] 脂质结构复杂、过程动态多变，使得解析代谢性疾病中的脂质重编程具有挑战性。将人工智能（AI）与脂质组学、质谱成像和脂质代谢通量组学相结合，可实现对脂质种类快速、高精度、深入的时空谱分析。本综述总结了AI赋能脂质组学的进展，这些进展不仅加速了时空数据处理，还为解析脂质代谢的异质性提供了新途径。重要的是，AI辅助的脂质组学可识别候选生物标志物，并就疾病机制提出可检验的假说。此外，我们通过考察注释置信度、定量准确性、跨平台可重复性、不确定性校准和外部验证，评估计算方法的进步是否能产生可信的证据。我们还讨论了AI辅助脂质组学目前的局限性，尤其是AI幻觉的风险。

title: Prediction of Human-Virus Protein-Protein Interactions.
source: PubMed · Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)
zh_title: 人-病毒蛋白质相互作用预测
summary: 综述以深度学习多模态融合框架为主的人-病毒蛋白质相互作用计算预测方法，及其对抗病毒药物和疫苗设计的意义。
key_points: 传统Y2H、AP-MS通量低、成本高、假阳性高

abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] Human-Virus Protein-Protein Interactions (HV-PPIs) are the core mechanisms underlying viral invasion of host cells, completion of the viral life cycle, and induction of pathological responses. Predicting HV-PPIs in higher accuracy is of great significance for elucidating viral pathogenic mechanisms, developing antiviral drugs, and designing vaccines. However, traditional experimental methods such as Yeast Two-Hybrid (Y2H) and Affinity Purification-Mass Spectrometry (AP-MS) face bottlenecks including low throughput, high cost, high false positive rates, and incomplete data in the identification of cross-species interactions. In recent years, computational biology approaches, especially deep learning-based multimodal fusion frameworks, have emerged as the primary driving force for accelerating HV-PPIs prediction. This review systematically summarizes the latest advances in the field of HV-PPIs prediction, elaborates on key aspects such as data construction, feature engineering, deep learning architectures, and performance evaluation, summarizes the technical essentials, advantages, and limitations of existing methods, discusses the development trends of the field by integrating representative research findings from recent years, and serves as a reference for future investigations in this domain.
zh_abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] 人-病毒蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（HV-PPIs）是病毒侵入宿主细胞、完成病毒生命周期并诱发病理反应的核心机制。更准确地预测HV-PPIs对于阐明病毒致病机制、开发抗病毒药物和设计疫苗具有重要意义。然而，酵母双杂交（Y2H）和亲和纯化-质谱（AP-MS）等传统实验方法在鉴定跨物种相互作用时面临通量低、成本高、假阳性率高和数据不完整等瓶颈。近年来，计算生物学方法，尤其是基于深度学习的多模态融合框架，已成为加速HV-PPIs预测的主要驱动力。本综述系统总结了HV-PPIs预测领域的最新进展，阐述了数据构建、特征工程、深度学习架构和性能评估等关键环节，归纳了现有方法的技术要点、优势与局限，结合近年来的代表性研究成果讨论了该领域的发展趋势，并为该领域未来研究提供参考。

title: Buy the Workflow, Not the Algorithm: When Should Radiology Pay for Artificial Intelligence?

AI tools are most likely to be successful when implemented as part of a service line with dedicated human personnel to receive AI notifications and integration of AI findings into care pathways.

title: Individual Treatment Effect Estimation Based on AI.
source: PubMed · Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)
zh_title: 基于AI的个体治疗效应估计
summary: 该书章综述AI用于个体治疗效应（ITE）估计的主要思路与方法，讨论传统亚组分析的局限，并指出临床常规应用仍很少。
key_points: 超越平均治疗效应
讨论亚组分析局限
方法落地临床者仍少
reason: 方法学综述章节，泛泛介绍，增量档
abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] The rapid growth of electronic health records, clinical trial repositories, and real-world medical data creates new opportunities for estimating how treatment effects vary across patients. In recent years, a wide range of artificial intelligence (AI)-based methods has been developed to move beyond average treatment effects (ATE) and support more individualized treatment decisions. However, despite this methodological progress, only a small number of these approaches are used in routine clinical practice. At the same time, precision medicine highlights the limitations of relying solely on population-average treatment effects. In this chapter, we review the main ideas and methods underlying AI-based individual treatment effect (ITE) estimation. We discuss the limitations of conventional subgroup analysis and introduce the major classes of conditional average treatment effect (CATE) estimation methods, including outcome modeling, effect modeling, and deep causal learning approaches. We further illustrate their use in both randomized trials and observational studies, with examples from intensive blood pressure control and sepsis care, and highlight the evaluation and interpretability challenges essential for clinical translation.
zh_abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] 电子健康记录、临床试验库和真实世界医疗数据的快速增长，为估计治疗效果在不同患者之间的差异带来了新的机遇。近年来，已发展出多种基于人工智能（AI）的方法，用于超越平均治疗效应（ATE），并支持更加个体化的治疗决策。然而，尽管方法学不断进步，这些方法中只有少数用于常规临床实践。与此同时，精准医学凸显了仅依赖人群平均治疗效应的局限性。在本章中，我们回顾了基于AI的个体治疗效应（ITE）估计的主要思想和方法。我们讨论了传统亚组分析的局限性，并介绍了条件平均治疗效应（CATE）估计方法的主要类别，包括结局建模、效应建模和深度因果学习方法。我们进一步结合强化血压控制和脓毒症救治的实例，说明这些方法在随机试验和观察性研究中的应用，并强调了临床转化所必需的评估和可解释性方面的挑战。

title: Deep Learning for Protein-Compound Interaction Prediction: Methods and Generalization.
source: PubMed · Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)
zh_title: 蛋白-化合物相互作用预测的深度学习：方法与泛化
summary: 综述梳理PCI预测在任务定义、表示、架构、基准与评估实践方面的进展，强调分布偏移下的可靠性与数据划分、指标选择的影响。
key_points: 标准基准表现不一定转化为发现成果
分布偏移下准确率可显著下降
强调标签定义、数据划分与指标选择
reason: 有信息量的综述，综述类上限，药物发现略加分
abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] Deep learning now underpins most protein-compound interaction (PCI) prediction pipelines, spanning virtual screening, affinity estimation, and lead optimization. Yet strong numbers on standard benchmarks do not reliably translate into discovery outcomes: accuracy can drop sharply under distribution shift, many predictions are hard to rationalize or corroborate with physical evidence, and reported performance is often sensitive to how labels are defined, how data are split, and which metrics are emphasized. In this review, we introduce recent progress in deep learning for PCI prediction across task definitions, protein/ligand representations, interaction modeling architectures, benchmark resources, and evaluation practice, emphasizing the methodological choices that determine reliability outside curated test sets. We relate widely used label and task setups to their underlying assumptions and typical failure modes, analyze how redundancy and similarity leakage can inflate in-distribution results, and highlight recurring trade-offs between model expressiveness, scalability, physical realism, and generalization to unseen targets or chemotypes. We end by outlining practical priorities for evaluation and reporting, including split protocols matched to the intended deployment scenario, explicit treatment of assay heterogeneity, uncertainty-aware and decision-focused metrics, and benchmark designs that better anticipate prospective utility.
zh_abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] 深度学习目前已成为大多数蛋白质-化合物相互作用（PCI）预测流程的基础，涵盖虚拟筛选、亲和力估计和先导化合物优化。然而，在标准基准上取得的优异数值并不能可靠地转化为药物发现的成果：在分布偏移下准确率可能急剧下降，许多预测难以解释或难以得到物理证据的佐证，且所报告的性能往往对标签的定义方式、数据的划分方式以及所强调的评价指标十分敏感。在本综述中，我们介绍了深度学习用于PCI预测在任务定义、蛋白质/配体表示、相互作用建模架构、基准资源和评估实践等方面的最新进展，重点强调那些决定模型在经过整理的测试集之外是否可靠的方法学选择。我们将常用的标签和任务设置与其潜在假设及典型失效模式相联系，分析冗余和相似性泄漏如何夸大分布内结果，并强调模型表达能力、可扩展性、物理真实性以及对未见靶点或化学型的泛化能力之间反复出现的权衡。最后，我们概述了评估和报告方面的实际优先事项，包括与预期部署场景相匹配的数据划分方案、对实验检测异质性的明确处理、考虑不确定性且以决策为导向的指标，以及能更好预见前瞻性实用价值的基准设计。

title: SCALE: Towards Whole-Slide Counterfactual Explanations in Cancer Histopathology
zh_title: SCALE：癌症病理全切片反事实解释框架
summary: 提出SCALE框架，为组织病理全切片图像（WSI）模型预测生成反事实解释，以缓解深度学习模型缺乏可解释性的问题（预印本，未经同行评审）。

摘要截断，验证细节与效果未知

abstract: Accurate cancer diagnosis depends on histopathological evaluation, in which tumor morphology drives disease classification and therapeutic decision-making. While deep learning models have demonstrated strong performance in predicting diagnostic and prognostic properties from histopathology images, their clinical adoption remains limited by a lack of interpretability. Unlike conventional medical images where diagnostic findings are spatially localized, histopathological images are characterized by complex textural patterns distributed across the entire whole slide image (WSI), making it difficult to explain model predictions through region-based localization alone. Counterfactual explanations offer a promising alternative by asking "what changes in the image could have altered the model prediction." To achieve this, we propose SCALE, a framework for generating such counterfactual explanat
zh_abstract: 准确的癌症诊断依赖于组织病理学评估，其中肿瘤形态学决定疾病分类和治疗决策。尽管深度学习模型在根据组织病理学图像预测诊断和预后特性方面表现出色，但由于缺乏可解释性，其临床应用仍然受限。与诊断所见在空间上具有定位性的传统医学图像不同，组织病理学图像的特点是复杂的纹理模式分布于整张全切片图像（WSI），仅凭基于区域定位难以解释模型预测。反事实解释通过提出“图像中发生哪些改变可能会改变模型预测”这一问题，提供了一种有前景的替代方案。为实现这一目标，我们提出了SCALE，一种用于生成此类反事实解释的框架（原文在此处截断）

title: Why Trust Your Agent? Empirical Security Gains from TRiSM-Guided Agentic Workflows in Healthcare
zh_title: TRiSM框架引导的医疗智能体工作流安全性实证
summary: 将TRiSM框架用于医学报告生成应用，在5个LLM上测试800次生成与500次攻击，RAG投毒攻击成功率由31%降至10%，另一类由42%降至25%。

abstract: Agent-based AI has enabled the automation of tasks by exposing application tools and resources to large language models (LLMs). However, to improve scope and accuracy, agents are often given access rights that exceed those of ordinary users, introducing significant security risks and potential regulatory breaches. This paper applies the AI Trust, Risk, and Security Management (TRiSM) framework to a medical report-generation application to demonstrate how an insecure baseline workflow can be transformed into a security-conscious agentic workflow. abstract: [Current opinion in ophthalmology] This review examines the current state of artificial intelligence (AI) models for the detection and prediction of glaucomatous progression. Machine learning and deep learning models have been developed to analyze longitudinal data from optic disc photographs, optical coherence tomography images, and visual field tests to identify worsening glaucoma. Recent AI research has also expanded beyond simply detecting progression to predicting future disease trajectories. These approaches may provide more efficient assessment than clinician review alone. AI models can rapidly analyze large volumes of clinical data to support individualized glaucoma management; these models can guide treatment intensity and follow-up intervals by detecting and predicting glaucomatous progression. However, significant hurdles to clinical adoption remain, including the "black box" nature of AI, absence of a universally accepted reference standard for progression, variable data quality, and limited generalizability across populations and clinical settings. AI is poised to function as a clinical decision support tool rather than a replacement for clinicians. Prospective studies are needed to determine the impact of AI in improving patient outcomes, clinical efficiency, and healthcare costs.
zh_abstract: [眼科学最新观点] 本综述探讨了用于检测和预测青光眼进展的人工智能（AI）模型的现状。目前已开发出机器学习和深度学习模型，可分析来自视盘照片、光学相干断层扫描图像和视野检查的纵向数据，以识别青光眼的恶化。近期的 AI 研究也已不再局限于检测进展，而是扩展到预测未来的疾病轨迹。与单纯依靠临床医生阅片相比，这些方法可能提供更高效的评估。AI 模型能够快速分析大量临床数据，以支持个体化的青光眼管理；通过检测和预测青光眼进展，这些模型可以指导治疗强度和随访间隔。然而，临床应用仍存在重大障碍，包括 AI 的“黑箱”性质、缺乏普遍接受的青光眼进展参考标准、数据质量参差不齐，以及在不同人群和临床环境中的泛化能力有限。AI 有望作为临床决策支持工具，而非取代临床医生。需要开展前瞻性研究，以确定 AI 在改善患者结局、提高临床效率和降低医疗费用方面的影响。

abstract: [Critical care explorations] Bag-mask ventilation (BMV) is a critical phase of pediatric airway management, yet objective feedback remains limited. To develop and validate a two-stage, CO2-only framework for pediatric BMV assessment comprising automated breath segmentation and machine learning classification of breaths according to predefined low-quality criteria for insufficient ventilation. We hypothesized that our model would achieve area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) greater than or equal to 0.75 and area under the precision-recall curve (AUPRC) greater than or equal to 0.75. We retrospectively analyzed capnography waveforms from 85 critically ill children receiving peri-intubation BMV in a quaternary-care PICU. Flow and pressure data established reference-standard low-quality criteria: expiratory tidal volume (VTE) less than 4 mL/kg of ideal body weight, mask leak greater than 40%, or upper airway obstruction (VTE 30 cm H2O and leak > 80%). CO2-based segmentation was validated in 10 randomly selected patients comprising 605 manually adjudicated breaths. Classification performance was internally validated using repeated 10-fold cross-validation within the derivation cohort; no independent validation cohort was used. A rule-based algorithm segmented continuous CO2 waveforms into breaths. Deep learning architectures then used CO2 waveforms alone to classify breaths according to whether they met predefined low-quality criteria. The CO2-only algorithm identified 6942 breaths (median, 66 per patient [interquartile range, 47-100 per patient]); 49.5% met at least one low-quality criterion. Segmentation achieved positive predictive value 0.95 (95% CI, 0.93-0.96) and sensitivity 0.86 (95% CI, 0.83-0.89). Twenty-seven breaths were adjudicated as false-positive detections (0.05; 95% CI, 0.036-0.074). CO2-only segmentation may miss ventilatory attempts with minimal or absent exhaled CO2. The best-performing classification model achieved AUROC 0.79 (95% CI, 0.66-0.89) and AUPRC 0.75 (95% CI, 0.57-0.88). A CO2-only framework showed proof-of-concept feasibility for breath segmentation and quality classification during pediatric BMV, supporting further development of objective bedside feedback systems.
zh_abstract: [Critical care explorations] 球囊面罩通气（BMV）是儿科气道管理的关键阶段，但客观反馈仍然有限。目的：开发并验证一个仅基于二氧化碳（CO2）的两阶段儿科 BMV 评估框架，包括自动呼吸分段，以及依据预先定义的通气不足低质量标准对呼吸进行机器学习分类。我们假设该模型的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）≥0.75，精确率-召回率曲线下面积（AUPRC）≥0.75。我们回顾性分析了某四级医疗中心儿科重症监护病房（PICU）85 名在气管插管围术期接受 BMV 的危重症儿童的二氧化碳描记波形。以流量和压力数据确立参考标准低质量标准：呼气潮气量（VTE）低于 4 mL/kg 理想体重、面罩漏气大于 40%，或上气道梗阻（VTE 30 cm H2O 且漏气 > 80%）。基于 CO2 的分段在随机选取的 10 名患者中进行验证，共 605 次经人工判定的呼吸。分类性能在推导队列内通过重复 10 折交叉验证进行内部验证；未使用独立验证队列。基于规则的算法将连续 CO2 波形分割为呼吸，随后深度学习架构仅使用 CO2 波形，根据呼吸是否符合预定义的低质量标准进行分类。仅基于 CO2 的算法识别出 6942 次呼吸（中位数每例患者 66 次［四分位间距，每例 47–100 次］）；其中 49.5% 至少符合一项低质量标准。分段的阳性预测值为 0.95（95% CI，0.93–0.96），敏感度为 0.86（95% CI，0.83–0.89）。27 次呼吸被判定为假阳性检出（0.05；95% CI，0.036–0.074）。仅基于 CO2 的分段可能漏掉呼出 CO2 极少或没有的通气尝试。表现最佳的分类模型取得 AUROC 0.79（95% CI，0.66–0.89）和 AUPRC 0.75（95% CI，0.57–0.88）。仅基于 CO2 的框架在儿科 BMV 期间的呼吸分段和质量分类方面显示出概念验证的可行性，支持进一步开发客观的床旁反馈系统。

abstract: [Frontiers in neurology] To evaluate contrast-enhanced T1-weighted MRI (CE-T1WI) models for preoperative prediction of isocitrate dehydrogenase (IDH) mutation status in adult-type diffuse gliomas and explore phenotype associations of influential latent features. This retrospective study included 462 patients. Center 1 provided training (n = 259) and internal-test (n = 65) cohorts, and Center 2 provided external validation (n = 138). Five input-architecture combinations and six classifiers were evaluated against an interpretable logistic benchmark combining age and Visually Accessible Rembrandt Images (VASARI) descriptors. For each architecture, the classifier with the highest observed external area under the curve (AUC) was selected for reporting. Performance was assessed using discrimination, calibration, decision curves, and 100 downstream refits with fixed deep features. Shapley additive explanations (SHAP) and phenotype association analyses examined influential latent features and their relationships with clinical and imaging phenotypes. Region-of-interest (ROI)-constrained three-dimensional vision Transformer (3D ViT) with a support vector machine (SVM) achieved an external AUC of 0.929 (95% CI, 0.885-0.973), accuracy of 0.848, sensitivity of 0.838, specificity of 0.857, and Brier score of 0.106. The age-VASARI benchmark achieved an external AUC of 0.782. Across downstream refits, the ROI-constrained model had a mean external AUC of 0.930 and the smallest mean training-minus-external AUC difference (0.019). The same 10 features formed the highest-importance SHAP set across cohorts, with different rank orders. Feature_546 correlated with age (r = 0.461), postoperative Ki-67 (r = 0.562), and enhancement quality (r = 0.678; all adjusted p < 0.001). ROI-constrained volumetric learning from CE-T1WI showed promising cross-center IDH discrimination using one routine MRI sequence. Influential latent features were associated with postoperative Ki-67 and recognizable imaging phenotypes. SHAP attribution and these exploratory associations provide complementary perspectives on model behavior in preoperative IDH assessment.

abstract: Anomaly detection in medical images is a complex task, requiring the development of a robust model using only healthy patient data. Without access to labeled data, modern approaches typically employ self-supervised learning to obtain a model of normality. Since world models promise to build strong internal representations of their environment, we consider them as suitable candidates for the medical anomaly detection environment, namely medical investigations of healthy patients. To this end, we propose MADJEPA, a medical anomaly detector based on an enhanced multi-stage joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA). We design a multi-stage training pipeline to produce a robust detector: (1) image-based JEPA (I-JEPA) training aims to learn a strong representation of normal training data; (2) target encoder distillation aims to modulate over-generalization of I-JEPA representations to abn
zh_abstract: 医学图像中的异常检测是一项复杂的任务，需要仅使用健康患者的数据来构建稳健的模型。在无法获得标注数据的情况下，现代方法通常采用自监督学习来获得正常性模型。由于世界模型有望建立对其环境的强大内部表征，我们认为它们适合用于医学异常检测场景，即对健康患者进行的医学检查。为此，我们提出了 MADJEPA，一种基于增强型多阶段联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）的医学异常检测器。我们设计了多阶段训练流程以获得稳健的检测器：（1）基于图像的 JEPA（I-JEPA）训练旨在学习正常训练数据的强表征；（2）目标编码器蒸馏旨在调节 I-JEPA 表征对异常的过度泛化

abstract: ProteinGeoBench is a set of 131 tasks that give an agent protein structure files and ask it to look up recorded facts, check sequences, calculate geometry from atom coordinates or reason about structures. We ran four frontier models on every task several times (4,249 runs) and 26 models on a subset. A single overall score hides two different skills. Three of the four frontier models are best at looking up facts and worst at calculating from coordinates: Claude Opus 5 scores 0.907 on lookup and 0.716 on calculation. Gemini 3.1 Pro is the exception. Geometry is overrepresented among the hardest tasks. Half of the twelve tasks that all four models fail are calculations, although calculations are a fifth of the suite, and eight of the twelve were solved by none of the 26 models. abstract: Predicting the transcriptional response to combined perturbations requires distinguishing interactions between interventions from errors in their individual effect estimates. The latter become more pronounced when single-perturbation evidence is sparse or withheld. We introduce a conditional flow-matching model that estimates the reliability of single-gene effects from training-only cross-fitting and uses those estimates to calibrate the additive source distribution. The velocity is decomposed into a known correction of the additive reference and a learned residual transport field. On Norman genetic perturbations, reduces mean absolute error (MAE) from 0.142 to 0.131 for unseen combinations of observed singles and from 0.198 to 0.178 when constituent singles are withheld. title: How Well Do Generalist CT Foundation Models Differentiate Liver Tumors?
zh_title: 通用CT基础模型能否鉴别肝脏肿瘤？
summary: 回顾性评估RADAR与Merlin在517例多期CT肝肿瘤四分类中的零样本和线性探测表现，RADAR零样本准确率54.4%。

abstract: Generalist CT foundation models detect many findings with high performance, but their ability to differentiate detected lesions remains largely unevaluated. This retrospective study evaluated two generalist models, RADAR and Merlin, for differentiating liver tumors using a public single-institution multiphase CT dataset (517 cases: hepatocellular carcinoma, intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma, breast and colorectal cancer liver metastases, and hemangioma). The models were evaluated in a zero-shot setting using their existing outputs and with linear probing, in which only a linear classifier was trained on frozen image features (stratified fivefold cross-validation repeated five times). In the zero-shot setting, RADAR achieved an accuracy of 54.4% (95% CI: 49.9, 58.8) and a $κ$ of 0.37 for four-class differentiation at the portal venous phase and predicted 31% (129 of 421) of malignant tumors
zh_abstract: 通用型CT基础模型能够以较高性能检出多种影像学发现，但其对所检出病灶进行鉴别的能力在很大程度上尚未得到评估。这项回顾性研究使用一个公开的单中心多期相CT数据集（517例：肝细胞癌、肝内胆管癌、乳腺癌和结直肠癌肝转移瘤，以及血管瘤），评估了两种通用型模型 RADAR 和 Merlin 对肝脏肿瘤的鉴别能力。模型分别在零样本设置下（使用其现有输出）以及线性探测（linear probing）下进行评估；线性探测仅在冻结的图像特征上训练线性分类器（分层五折交叉验证，重复五次）。在零样本设置下，RADAR 在门静脉期的四分类鉴别中准确率为 54.4%（95% CI：49.9，58.8），$κ$ 为 0.37，并预测了 31%（421 例中的 129 例）的恶性肿瘤

abstract: Predicting the RNA and protein content of cells from routine H&E images could extend spatial molecular profiling to existing slide archives. However, both H&E-spatial proteomics and H&E-spatial transcriptomics paired datasets are limited by the number of available markers and the insufficient availability of high-quality, cell-resolved data. We present SCOPE (Single-Cell Omics Prediction via RNA-protein prior Enhancement), a unified framework that leverages biologically complementary information between RNA and proteins to address the limited availability of single-omics supervision. Our key insight is that, although RNA and proteins represent distinct molecular modalities, their biological relationships provide valuable shared knowledge that can benefit single-omics prediction tasks. To this end, SCOPE introduces biologically informed biomarker priors to enhance shared gene-level repres
zh_abstract: 从常规 H&E 图像预测细胞的 RNA 和蛋白质含量，可将空间分子谱分析扩展到现有的切片档案。然而，H&E-空间蛋白质组学与 H&E-空间转录组学的配对数据集均受限于可用标志物的数量，以及高质量、细胞分辨率数据的不足。我们提出 SCOPE（Single-Cell Omics Prediction via RNA-protein prior Enhancement，通过 RNA-蛋白质先验增强进行单细胞组学预测），这是一个统一框架，利用 RNA 与蛋白质之间生物学上的互补信息，以应对单组学监督数据有限的问题。我们的核心见解是：尽管 RNA 和蛋白质代表不同的分子模态，但它们之间的生物学关系提供了有价值的共享知识，可使单组学预测任务受益。为此，SCOPE 引入了基于生物学知识的生物标志物先验，以增强共享的基因水平表征

abstract: State-of-the-art Extreme Multi-Label Text Classification models rely on multi-label attention to focus on key tokens in input text, but learning good attention weights is challenging. We introduce PLANT (Pretrained and Leveraged AtteNTion), a plug-and-play strategy for initializing the label-attention module that operates on top of an LLM's output representations. PLANT works by planting label-specific attention using a Learning-to-Rank model trained on mutual information gain, before end-to-end fine-tuning. This architecture-agnostic approach integrates with LLM backbones (e.g., Mistral-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, DeepSeek-V3, and Phi-3-mini). PLANT outperforms SOTA methods across tasks like ICD coding, legal topic classification, and content recommendation, and improves fine-tuned LLMs in controlled comparisons outside the medical domain. zh_abstract: 最先进的极端多标签文本分类模型依赖多标签注意力来聚焦输入文本中的关键词元，但学习良好的注意力权重具有挑战性。我们提出了PLANT（Pretrained and Leveraged AtteNTion），这是一种即插即用的策略，用于初始化作用于大语言模型（LLM）输出表征之上的标签注意力模块。PLANT在端到端微调之前，利用基于互信息增益训练的学习排序（Learning-to-Rank）模型来植入标签特异性注意力。这一与架构无关的方法可与多种LLM骨干网络（如Mistral-7B、Llama-3.1-8B、DeepSeek-V3和Phi-3-mini）集成。PLANT在ICD编码、法律主题分类和内容推荐等任务上优于最先进方法，并且在医学领域之外的对照比较中提升了经微调的LLM的表现。增益在罕见标签上最大，尽管一种免训练的

abstract: Agents that do science must choose informative experiments and reason from their results, but most discovery benchmarks cannot separate that skill from recall, unstated scoring rules or shortcut policies. We introduce Openhagen Worlds, a suite of 27 procedurally generated environments (some with finite truth spaces), from classic puzzles of experimental reasoning to simulator-grounded physics and chemistry, in which an agent runs experiments under a budget and commits an answer that a deterministic verifier checks against a hidden truth. title: Elysium: Simulation-Free Unbalanced Schrödinger Bridges
zh_title: Elysium：免模拟的非平衡薛定谔桥
summary: 针对单细胞快照提出免轨迹模拟的求解器，联合学习状态转移与质量变化，以刻画增殖和凋亡下的细胞动力学。
key_points: 基于killed布朗参考及其时间反演

reason: 有新意的单细胞方法预印本，证据有限
abstract: Reconstructing cellular dynamics from snapshots is challenging because the destructive nature of single-cell measurements makes tracking the same cells over time impossible. Cellular dynamics are inherently stochastic and involve changes in population size through proliferation and apoptosis. Growth-based methods represent population change as a rate on the density, which does not assign exits and entries to individual cells. Unbalanced Schrödinger bridges model individual events, but neural solvers for killed diffusion bridges simulate trajectories during training. We introduce Elysium, a simulation-free solver that jointly learns state transition and mass change. Using a killed Brownian reference and its time reversal, Elysium constructs direct regression objectives from an optimal endpoint coupling and conditional bridge distributions, without simulating trajectories during training.

zh_abstract: 从空间转录组学中学习细胞的时空动态，需要将在不同坐标系下获得的不同细胞的快照联系起来。切片的旋转或平移可能表现为细胞移动，并扭曲推断出的对应关系。我们提出水平流匹配（horizontal flow matching），其在共享刚体运动的意义下学习组织结构、分子状态和细胞丰度的变化。该动力学遵循连续性—反应方程，其作用量对共享刚体运动不赋予任何代价，由此得到的水平投影算子在学习过程中从空间预测误差中、在生成过程中从预测速度中移除这一分量。一个等价的端点问题在 Wasserstein–Fisher–Rao 几何下联合估计对应关系和相对位姿，并给出解析路径，其速度和增长可作为回归目标。对这些（原文此处截断）

abstract: Small lesions in brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) are easily missed: a segmentation model can reach a high Dice similarity coefficient (DSC) while leaving many of them undetected.
