zh_abstract: 脑磁共振成像（MRI）中的小病灶很容易被漏检：分割模型可以获得很高的 Dice 相似系数（DSC），却仍有许多小病灶未被检出。我们探讨这种遗漏源于网络本身还是训练目标。在多发性硬化病灶分割中，使用默认 Dice 与交叉熵损失训练的 nnU-Net 对其漏检的大多数小病灶几乎没有响应，因此任何决策阈值都无法将其找回；而使用相同损失训练的其他四种架构，对这些病灶的检出也并不更多。因此，我们只改变训练目标。CATMIL 在 nnU-Net 损失中加入两个病灶层面的项：一是成分自适应 Tversky（Component-Adaptive Tversky，CAT）项，使每个病灶获得几乎与其大小无关的权重；二是多示例学习（Multiple Instance Learning，MIL）项，将每个病灶视为一个体素包，并对其中没有任何体素被检出的病灶进行惩罚……

title: NullFlow: One-Step Generative Reconstruction
zh_title: NullFlow：一步式生成重建
summary: 将生成流限制在测量一致子空间，单次网络评估即可重建，在图像修复与加速MRI上与扩散求解器相当。
key_points: 流限定于测量一致子空间，无需数据保真修正
学习平均速度实现单步采样
推理由数百次评估降至一次，代码开源
reason: 有开源代码的新方法预印本，医疗仅为加速MRI之一
abstract: We propose NullFlow, a principled framework for one-step generative image reconstruction. Our key idea is to confine the generative flow to a measurement-consistent subspace. Because the flow never leaves this subspace, NullFlow needs no separate data-fidelity corrections, unlike existing solvers. NullFlow samples in a single network evaluation by learning the flow's average velocity, avoiding the step-by-step integration of the traditional flow matching methods. We prove that the average velocity of this constrained flow provides a consistent training objective for learning a one-step posterior sampler. We empirically demonstrate on image inpainting and accelerated MRI that NullFlow matches state-of-the-art diffusion solvers while cutting inference from hundreds of network evaluations to one. Code is available at https://github.com/uw-cig/NullFlow.
zh_abstract: 我们提出 NullFlow，一种用于单步生成式图像重建的原理性框架。我们的核心思想是将生成流限制在与测量一致的子空间内。由于该流从不离开此子空间，与现有求解器不同，NullFlow 无需单独的数据保真度校正。NullFlow 通过学习流的平均速度，仅需一次网络评估即可完成采样，避免了传统流匹配方法的逐步积分。我们证明了该受约束流的平均速度为学习单步后验采样器提供了一致的训练目标。我们在图像修复和加速 MRI 上通过实验证明，NullFlow 可与最先进的扩散求解器相媲美，同时将推理过程从数百次网络评估降至一次。代码见 https://github.com/uw-cig/NullFlow。

abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] Pulmonary diseases currently pose significant threats to global health, spanning common chronic conditions including lung cancer, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), and asthma, as well as infectious and inflammatory diseases like tuberculosis, interstitial lung disease (ILD), and COVID-19. Therefore, accurate diagnosis, effective therapeutic strategies, and reliable assessment of prognosis for pulmonary diseases are essential for improving patient outcomes and safeguarding public health. Despite the increasing availability of medical imaging and pathological data owing to improvements in detection technologies, what is becoming increasingly evident are the limitations of conventional diagnosis, which relies solely on clinicians' subjective judgment based on imaging, pulmonary function, pathology, and clinical experience. In recent years, artificial intelligence (AI) technology, especially machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL), has made significant progress in areas such as image recognition and model construction. Numerous studies have demonstrated the widespread application of AI in the screening and diagnosis of lung diseases, the optimization of treatment strategies, and prognosis assessment, revealing its remarkable ability to process and interpret complex clinical data. Although concerns persist regarding data quality, the "black box" nature of algorithms, clinical practice, and the regulatory landscape, the application of AI in lung disease research and clinical care is more and more promising. In this review, we summarize the latest advances of AI in the diagnosis and treatment of pulmonary diseases, analyze the challenges and limitations of current AI technologies ranging from data and algorithms to clinical translation, and highlight directions for future research.
zh_abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] 肺部疾病目前对全球健康构成重大威胁，涵盖肺癌、慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）和哮喘等常见慢性疾病，以及结核病、间质性肺疾病（ILD）和COVID-19等感染性和炎症性疾病。因此，准确的诊断、有效的治疗策略以及可靠的预后评估对于改善患者结局和维护公共卫生至关重要。尽管随着检测技术的进步，医学影像和病理数据日益增多，但传统诊断仅依赖临床医生基于影像、肺功能、病理和临床经验的主观判断，其局限性日益凸显。近年来，人工智能（AI）技术，尤其是机器学习（ML）和深度学习（DL），在图像识别和模型构建等领域取得了显著进展。大量研究已证明AI在肺部疾病的筛查与诊断、治疗策略优化及预后评估中得到广泛应用，显示出其处理和解释复杂临床数据的卓越能力。尽管在数据质量、算法的“黑箱”特性、临床实践和监管环境方面仍存在担忧，但AI在肺部疾病研究和临床诊疗中的应用前景越来越广阔。在本综述中，我们总结了AI在肺部疾病诊断与治疗中的最新进展，分析了当前AI技术从数据、算法到临床转化所面临的挑战和局限，并指出了未来的研究方向。

abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] With the development of artificial intelligence (AI), AI-assisted clinical diagnosis, driven by big data analytics and machine/deep learning (ML/DL), has brought great changes in clinical decision. AI enhances disease detection, classification, and treatment planning by processing diverse data such as electronic health records (EHRs), medical images, and genomics. Key applications include high-accuracy cancer screening, neurological disorder prediction, and diagnostics in ophthalmology, endocrinology, and pediatrics. Significant challenges involve data quality/standardization, model interpretability, and ethical/legal concerns. Mitigation strategies include federated learning, Explainable AI, and fairness constraints. Future directions focus on multimodal data fusion, real-time monitoring via wearables, and collaborative human-AI diagnostics. AI is positioned as a tool to augment clinicians, promising improved diagnostic precision, efficiency, and accessibility in precision medicine, contingent on overcoming technical and ethical hurdles through interdisciplinary collaboration.

abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] Precision medicine, which involves tailoring medical treatment to the individual characteristics of each patient, is poised for a new era of advancement through artificial intelligence (AI). This chapter explores the future directions of precision medicine in the context of AI-driven innovation, focusing on emerging technologies and their impact on personalized care. We discuss recent breakthroughs in AI-enabled diagnostics, genomics, drug discovery, and clinical decision-making, highlighting how these developments are reshaping the practice of medicine. We also examine the challenges and opportunities in implementing AI for precision medicine, including data integration, model interpretability, regulatory considerations, and ethical issues. Drawing on high-impact research and reports from leading institutions, we present a forward-looking analysis of how AI will drive the next generation of personalized treatments. The convergence of AI and precision medicine promises to revolutionize healthcare by improving early disease detection, optimizing therapy selection, and enabling truly individualized patient care.

abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] In the rapidly evolving field of artificial intelligence (AI), statistics plays a crucial role in addressing challenges faced by medical AI. This review begins by highlighting the primary tasks of medical AI and the integration of statistical methodologies into their modeling processes. Despite the widespread application of AI in medicine and healthcare, key challenges persist: poor model interpretability, lack of causal reasoning, overfitting, unfairness, imbalanced datasets, AI "hallucinations" and "disinformation." Statistics provides unique strategies to tackle these challenges, including rigorous statistical design, regularization techniques, and statistical frameworks grounded in causal inference. Finally, the review offers several recommendations for the sustainable development of medical AI: enhancing data quality, promoting model simplicity and transparency, fostering independent validation standards, and facilitating interdisciplinary collaboration between statisticians and medical AI practitioners.
zh_abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] 在快速发展的人工智能（AI）领域，统计学在应对医学 AI 所面临的挑战中发挥着关键作用。本综述首先强调医学 AI 的主要任务，以及统计学方法在其建模过程中的整合。尽管 AI 在医学和医疗保健中得到广泛应用，但仍存在一些关键挑战：模型可解释性差、缺乏因果推理、过拟合、不公平、数据集不平衡，以及 AI 的“幻觉”和“虚假信息”。统计学提供了应对这些挑战的独特策略，包括严谨的统计设计、正则化技术以及以因果推断为基础的统计框架。最后，本综述为医学 AI 的可持续发展提出若干建议：提高数据质量，促进模型的简洁性与透明性，推动独立验证标准，并促进统计学家与医学 AI 从业者之间的跨学科合作。

abstract: [International wound journal] We examined the impact of a polymeric membrane dressing thickness on its prophylactic efficacy for preventing heel pressure injuries, with the aim of identifying an optimal balance between tissue protection and conformability. An innovative framework was applied that integrated artificial intelligence (AI) predictive analysis with biomechanical finite element (FE) modelling. Two AI approaches were used: (i) interactive dialogue to validate reasoning, and (ii) repeated statistical queries to assess prediction consistency. Both a general-purpose AI model and a fine-tuned domain-specific model were tested, showing convergence toward an optimal dressing thickness of 3 to 5 mm. To validate these AI predictions, FE simulations were conducted for dressings of 3, 4 and 5 mm thickness under combined compressive and shear loading of the heel in a supine position. Protective efficacy was quantified using the protective efficacy index, whereas conformability was assessed through bending stiffness. The results indicated that thicker dressing improves tissue protection but reduces flexibility, as could be expected, and importantly, the AI-FE methodology was powerful in supporting the design process. Specifically, among the tested options, the 4 mm thickness provided the most favourable trade-off, offering substantially greater protection than 3 mm while retaining higher conformability than 5 mm. This thickness also aligned with the most frequent AI-generated prediction, reinforcing confidence in the integrated AI-FE workflow. Overall, we demonstrated the potential of AI-assisted design to streamline wound care research and development processes by narrowing design parameter ranges, reducing the reliance on trial-and-error testing and hence lowering the development costs.
zh_abstract: [International wound journal] 我们研究了聚合物膜敷料厚度对其预防足跟压力性损伤的预防效果的影响，旨在寻找组织保护与贴合性之间的最佳平衡。研究采用了一种将人工智能（AI）预测分析与生物力学有限元（FE）建模相结合的创新框架。使用了两种AI方法：（i）通过交互式对话验证推理，以及（ii）通过重复统计查询评估预测一致性。同时测试了通用AI模型和经微调的特定领域模型，二者均趋向于3至5 mm的最佳敷料厚度。为验证这些AI预测，对仰卧位足跟在压缩与剪切联合载荷下的3、4和5 mm厚度敷料进行了有限元模拟。保护效果采用保护效能指数量化，贴合性则通过弯曲刚度评估。结果表明，如预期所料，较厚的敷料可改善组织保护但降低柔韧性，重要的是，AI-FE方法对支持设计过程作用显著。具体而言，在所测试的方案中，4 mm厚度提供了最有利的权衡：其保护作用明显优于3 mm，同时贴合性高于5 mm。该厚度也与AI最常生成的预测一致，增强了对整合AI-FE工作流程的信心。总体而言，我们证明了AI辅助设计在简化伤口护理研发流程方面的潜力，可通过缩小设计参数范围、减少对试错测试的依赖，从而降低研发成本。

abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] With the advancement of precision medicine, pharmacogenomics (PGx) is playing an increasingly important role in guiding personalized drug therapy. The rapid development of artificial intelligence (AI) technologies, particularly machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL), is infusing new momentum into PGx research and significantly accelerating its translational applications in clinical settings. This review systematically summarizes recent progress and practical applications of AI in the field of PGx. We highlight that AI not only enhances the interpretation of complex genetic variations but also uncovers potential mechanisms of drug response and adverse reactions from large-scale heterogeneous data, thereby exerting substantial influence on both drug development and clinical pharmacotherapy. Nevertheless, the clinical implementation of AI in PGx still faces multiple challenges, including data bias, limited model generalizability, insufficient regulatory frameworks, and ethical and legal concerns. In the future, with continued optimization of algorithms, interdisciplinary collaboration, and the establishment of robust ethical standards, AI is expected to play a more central role in advancing personalized medicine and bridging the gap between research and clinical practice.
zh_abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] 随着精准医学的发展，药物基因组学（PGx）在指导个体化药物治疗中发挥着越来越重要的作用。人工智能（AI）技术，尤其是机器学习（ML）和深度学习（DL）的快速发展，正为PGx研究注入新的动力，并显著加速其在临床环境中的转化应用。本综述系统总结了AI在PGx领域的最新进展和实际应用。我们强调，AI不仅增强了对复杂遗传变异的解读，还能从大规模异质性数据中揭示药物反应和不良反应的潜在机制，从而对药物研发和临床药物治疗均产生重大影响。然而，AI在PGx中的临床实施仍面临多重挑战，包括数据偏倚、模型泛化能力有限、监管框架不足以及伦理和法律问题。未来，随着算法的持续优化、跨学科合作以及健全伦理标准的建立，AI有望在推进个体化医学、弥合研究与临床实践之间的差距方面发挥更核心的作用。

abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] Genome-wide association studies (GWAS) have been instrumental in uncovering the genetic basis of complex traits, yet classical single-variant testing remains limited in power and biological interpretability. Over the past decade, GWAS methodology has expanded from purely statistical association frameworks toward integrative models that incorporate functional annotations, multi-trait information, and data-driven prioritization strategies. Early developments leveraged regulatory genomics and cross-phenotype statistics to improve locus discovery, while machine learning approaches enabled systematic ranking of sub-threshold variants. More recently, deep learning architectures, including Transformer-based frameworks, have been introduced to integrate GWAS summary signals with linkage disequilibrium patterns and diverse genomic annotations. In parallel, multi-omics integration and transfer learning across related traits have emerged as practical solutions for limited sample sizes and population heterogeneity. This chapter reviews the evolving methodological landscape of AI-enabled GWAS, highlights key advances in variant discovery and functional interpretation, and discusses remaining challenges such as ancestry bias, interpretability, and the need for biological validation. Together, these approaches provide a foundation for more context-aware and scalable genetic studies of complex disease.
zh_abstract: [分子生物学方法（Methods in molecular biology，Clifton, N.J.）] 全基因组关联研究（GWAS）在揭示复杂性状的遗传基础方面发挥了重要作用，但经典的单变异检验在效能和生物学可解释性方面仍然有限。在过去十年中，GWAS 方法已从单纯的统计关联框架扩展到整合功能注释、多性状信息和数据驱动的优先级排序策略的整合模型。早期的发展利用调控基因组学和跨表型统计来改善位点发现，而机器学习方法则实现了对亚阈值变异的系统性排序。最近，包括基于 Transformer 的框架在内的深度学习架构被引入，用于将 GWAS 汇总信号与连锁不平衡模式及多种基因组注释相整合。与此同时，多组学整合以及跨相关性状的迁移学习已成为应对样本量有限和人群异质性的实用解决方案。本章回顾了人工智能赋能的 GWAS 不断演变的方法学格局，强调了变异发现和功能解释方面的关键进展，并讨论了仍然存在的挑战，如祖先偏倚、可解释性以及生物学验证的需求。总之，这些方法为开展更具情境感知性、更可扩展的复杂疾病遗传研究奠定了基础。

abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] The growing emphasis on personalized medicine is accelerating the shift toward precision healthcare, demanding real-time, high-frequency physiological data acquisition through minimally invasive or noninvasive means. Flexible wearable electronics have emerged as a transformative solution, overcoming the limitations of conventional rigid medical devices. By integrating highly compliant materials with miniaturized systems, these platforms enable continuous, stable, and comfortable monitoring of multimodal physiological signals such as electrocardiograms (ECG), body temperature, blood pressure, and sweat biomarkers. This chapter explores cutting-edge advances in flexible wearable technology, such as electronic skin with sweat management, implantable bioresorbable microneedles (IBMN), self-powered haptic interfaces, and deep learning-enhanced biosignal processing. We analyze the role of these innovations in advancing intelligent, patient-centric digital healthcare while addressing challenges in clinical translation and scalability.
zh_abstract: [分子生物学方法（Methods in molecular biology，Clifton, N.J.）] 对个体化医疗日益重视，正在加速向精准医疗的转变，这要求通过微创或无创方式获取实时、高频的生理数据。柔性可穿戴电子器件已成为一种变革性解决方案，克服了传统刚性医疗设备的局限。通过将高顺应性材料与微型化系统相结合，这些平台能够对心电图（ECG）、体温、血压和汗液生物标志物等多模态生理信号进行连续、稳定且舒适的监测。本章探讨柔性可穿戴技术的前沿进展，如具有汗液管理功能的电子皮肤、可植入生物可吸收微针（IBMN）、自供能触觉界面以及深度学习增强的生物信号处理。我们分析了这些创新在推进智能化、以患者为中心的数字医疗中的作用，同时探讨临床转化和规模化方面的挑战。

abstract: Clinical large language models are usually judged by whether the final answer is right. Within their encoded domains, systems with symbolic veto layers offer guarantees that hold relative to their encoded knowledge

abstract: Acquiring every feature of an instance is often costly: a measurement can carry a monetary price, a time delay, or a privacy cost. Active Feature Acquisition (AFA) addresses this by learning a policy that decides, per instance, which features to acquire under a budget. Existing AFA methods train this policy by optimizing a self-constructed utility target rather than distilling an explicit teacher. We construct this teacher explicitly. At training time the label and the unobserved feature values are available, and together they determine the teacher in closed form: an oracle that ranks every candidate by its effect on the downstream predictor's error. OracleImitator distills this ranking into a deployable policy by soft-target imitation. title: Precision immunopharmacology in xenotransplantation: integrating genome-engineered donors, organoid testbeds, and AI-guided translation.

summary: 综述探讨基因编辑供体猪、免疫药理、类器官测试平台与数据驱动决策系统如何整合以推进异种移植的临床转化。

abstract: [International immunopharmacology] Xenotransplantation is moving from isolated proof-of-concept procedures toward an engineered biotechnology platform for organ replacement. This review examines how genome-designed donor pigs, recipient-directed immunopharmacology, human-relevant in vitro testbeds, and data-driven decision systems can be integrated to address the remaining barriers to clinical translation. CRISPR-Cas-based engineering enables deletion of dominant carbohydrate xenoantigens, insertion of human complement- and coagulation-regulatory genes, modulation of innate and adaptive immune checkpoints, control of donor-organ growth, and inactivation of porcine endogenous retrovirus sequences. However, donor engineering does not eliminate residual T-cell, B-cell, antibody, complement, natural killer (NK) cell, macrophage, and inflammatory responses. Contemporary immunopharmacological strategies therefore increasingly combine costimulation blockade with complement inhibition, lymphocyte-directed therapy, and selected cytokine- or innate-immune interventions, with future regimens requiring closer integration of pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic monitoring with donor genotype and organ-specific risk. Organoids and microfluidic vascular systems may provide an intermediate testing layer by quantifying antibody binding, complement activation, endothelial injury, coagulation, leukocyte transmigration, cytokine responses, and tissue-specific function under controlled conditions before escalation to large-animal studies. Artificial intelligence may further support xenoantigen discovery, genome-editing design, donor-recipient matching, multimodal rejection surveillance, and ultimately clinician-supervised immunopharmacological decision support. We propose that these components should be connected through a traceable design-build-test-learn workflow linking computational prediction, donor construction, standardized functional testing, non-human-primate validation, and early human data. Durable translation will depend not on any single technological advance, but on reproducible donor manufacturing, precision immune control, validated human-relevant test systems, standardized longitudinal data, pathogen surveillance, organ-specific management, and transparent regulatory governance.
zh_abstract: [国际免疫药理学（International immunopharmacology）] 异种移植正从孤立的概念验证操作走向用于器官替代的工程化生物技术平台。本综述探讨基因组设计的供体猪、面向受者的免疫药理学、与人体相关的体外测试平台以及数据驱动的决策系统如何整合，以解决临床转化中尚存的障碍。基于 CRISPR-Cas 的工程技术可实现主要碳水化合物异种抗原的敲除、人类补体和凝血调节基因的插入、先天性和适应性免疫检查点的调控、供体器官生长的控制，以及猪内源性逆转录病毒序列的失活。然而，供体工程并不能消除残余的 T 细胞、B 细胞、抗体、补体、自然杀伤（NK）细胞、巨噬细胞及炎症反应。因此，当代免疫药理学策略越来越多地将共刺激阻断与补体抑制、淋巴细胞靶向治疗以及选定的细胞因子或先天免疫干预相结合，未来的方案需要将药代动力学和药效学监测与供体基因型及器官特异性风险更紧密地整合。类器官和微流控血管系统可作为中间测试层，在升级至大型动物研究之前，于可控条件下量化抗体结合、补体激活、内皮损伤、凝血、白细胞迁移、细胞因子反应和组织特异性功能。人工智能还可进一步支持异种抗原发现、基因组编辑设计、供受者匹配、多模态排斥监测，并最终支持由临床医生监督的免疫药理学决策。我们提出，这些组成部分应通过可追溯的“设计-构建-测试-学习”工作流程相互衔接，将计算预测、供体构建、标准化功能测试、非人灵长类验证和早期人体数据联系起来。持久的转化将不取决于任何单一技术进步，而取决于可重复的供体制备、精准的免疫控制、经验证的与人体相关的测试系统、标准化的纵向数据、病原体监测、器官特异性管理以及透明的监管治理。

abstract: [Frontiers in endocrinology] Thyroid cancer is one of the most common endocrine malignancies, and its rising incidence has increased the demand for more accurate and efficient diagnostic and management strategies. Current clinical management mainly relies on ultrasonography, fine-needle aspiration (FNA), surgery, radioactive iodine therapy, thyroid-stimulating hormone suppression, and systemic treatment in selected advanced cases. However, substantial interobserver variability, indeterminate cytology, and heterogeneity in tumor behavior still complicate diagnosis and risk stratification. In thyroid cancer, AI(Artificial intelligence) -assisted models have been applied to ultrasound, CT, MRI, cytology, histopathology, and genomic data, with promising performance in distinguishing benign from malignant nodules, predicting lymph node metastasis and key mutations, and supporting individualized management. This review critically synthesizes evidence across these applications, focusing on study design, validation strategies, generalizability, and clinical relevance. It also examines explainable AI, emerging foundation models, and regulatory and implementation challenges. Although many models report high diagnostic or predictive performance, these results alone do not establish improvements in clinical decision-making or patient outcomes. Prospective clinical validation, cost-effectiveness assessment, and evaluation of integration into clinical workflows are needed to determine whether AI provides meaningful benefits over standard care.
zh_abstract: [内分泌学前沿] 甲状腺癌是最常见的内分泌恶性肿瘤之一，其发病率上升增加了对更准确、更高效的诊断和管理策略的需求。目前的临床管理主要依赖超声检查、细针穿刺（FNA）、手术、放射性碘治疗、促甲状腺激素抑制以及部分晚期病例的全身治疗。然而，观察者间的显著差异、不确定的细胞学结果以及肿瘤行为的异质性，仍使诊断和风险分层复杂化。在甲状腺癌中，AI（人工智能）辅助模型已应用于超声、CT、MRI、细胞学、组织病理学和基因组数据，在鉴别良恶性结节、预测淋巴结转移和关键突变以及支持个体化管理方面表现出良好前景。本综述批判性地综合了这些应用的证据，重点关注研究设计、验证策略、可推广性和临床相关性。同时也探讨了可解释AI、新兴的基础模型，以及监管和实施方面的挑战。尽管许多模型报告了较高的诊断或预测性能，但仅凭这些结果并不能证明临床决策或患者结局得到改善。需要开展前瞻性临床验证、成本效益评估以及临床工作流程整合的评价，以确定AI相较于标准治疗是否带来实质性获益。

title: Spectral Vision Transformer for Efficient Tokenization with Limited Data
zh_title: 面向有限数据高效分词的谱视觉Transformer
summary: 提出以固定基的谱系数代替空间patch分词的ViT，在数据稀缺的医学影像等基准上表现相当或更优，并开源代码。
key_points: 每个token对应一个谱模态
序列长度可选，降低注意力成本
代码已开源
reason: 新架构有开源，但证据有限，偏通用方法
abstract: Vision transformers tokenize an image into patches, which couples the token count to resolution and requires the embedding to be learned from data. We propose a spectral vision transformer architecture for efficient tokenization in the limited-data regime, with an emphasis on medical imaging. Rather than using spatial patches, we tokenize into coefficients of a fixed basis. This approach defines each token as one spectral mode, and the sequence length is chosen rather than implied by resolution, reducing the cost of attention. Our proposed spectral ViT shows superior or comparable performance where data is scarce in public medical imaging benchmarks, natural images, object shapes, simulations, and protected clinical data. We release our code at: https://github.com/agr78/SpectralViT.
zh_abstract: 视觉 Transformer（Vision Transformer）将图像切分为图像块（patch）进行标记化，这使标记数量与分辨率相耦合，并要求从数据中学习嵌入。我们提出了一种谱视觉 Transformer 架构，用于在数据有限的情况下实现高效标记化，并侧重于医学影像。我们不使用空间图像块，而是将图像标记化为固定基的系数。这种方法把每个标记定义为一个谱模式，序列长度可以自行选择而不是由分辨率决定，从而降低了注意力的计算成本。在公共医学影像基准、自然图像、物体形状、模拟数据以及受保护的临床数据中，当数据稀缺时，我们提出的谱 ViT 表现更优或相当。我们在 https://github.com/agr78/SpectralViT 发布了代码。

abstract: Machine learning for neglected tropical diseases is limited by data, not algorithms: public annotated image sets for leprosy (Hansen's disease) number in the hundreds. We ask whether a model trained on abundant chronic wound photography transfers to this low-data regime. We evaluate on 136 held-out leprosy lesions using LPIPS anchored by a real-versus-real baseline, kernel inception distance (KID), and a paired design that runs both models on the same input. abstract: Causal discovery is increasingly applied to healthcare data, where the recovered relationships can encode biased pathways that propagate to downstream prediction. Path-specific fairness analysis, through direct, indirect, and spurious effect decompositions along with fairness-utility ratio assessment allows bias quantification and associated prediction cost. However, existing evaluations of causal discovery under fairness constraints have largely used non-clinical datasets and have not separated the contribution of confounders from that of mediators, leaving open how discovery-algorithm choice propagates through path-specific fairness to the utility trade-off in clinical settings. This work addresses that gap by establishing an expert-elicited causal graph benchmark for the heart failure clinical records dataset and tracing discovery algorithms through composite, per-variable fairness de
zh_abstract: 因果发现越来越多地应用于医疗数据，但所恢复的关系可能包含带有偏倚的路径，并传播到下游预测中。通过直接效应、间接效应和虚假效应分解以及公平性-效用比评估进行的路径特异性公平性分析，可以量化偏倚及相应的预测代价。然而，现有在公平性约束下对因果发现的评估大多使用非临床数据集，并且没有区分混杂因素与中介变量的贡献，因此在临床场景中，发现算法的选择如何通过路径特异性公平性传导至效用权衡仍不明确。本研究通过为心力衰竭临床记录数据集建立专家构建的因果图基准，并通过复合的、逐变量的公平性分解追踪各发现算法，来填补这一空白。

abstract: Kicker is a personal health assistant. Changes to an assistant's reusable instructions can improve task handling while changing what it discloses, which requests it follows, and how it reports actions. We study Safe Personal RSI, an update-evaluation component developed for Kicker. We restrict recursive self-improvement (RSI) to prompt updates, with model weights and runtime code fixed. The procedure tests proposed and current instructions, repeats failing cases, temporarily undoes changes to guide repairs, and checks safety and task performance before adoption. If no version passes, the current instructions stay in use. abstract: The electric power sector is a leading source of air pollutant emissions, impacting the public health of nearly every community. abstract: X-ray, known for its ability to reveal internal structures of objects, is expected to provide richer information for 3D reconstruction than visible light. Yet, existing neural radiance fields (NeRF) algorithms overlook this important nature of X-ray, leading to their limitations in capturing structural contents of imaged objects. Firstly, we design a Line Segment-based Transformer (Lineformer) as the backbone of SAX-NeRF. Linefomer captures internal structures of objects in 3D space by modeling the dependencies within each line segment of an X-ray. abstract: Motivation: Pathogen phylogenies are useful for monitoring the evolution of pathogens and for detecting new variants, as it provides information that can aid public health decisions and outbreak response. Since not all infections are sequenced, certain pathogen lineages may be missing or only poorly represented in reconstructed phylogenies. Identifying these gaps could help to determine where additional data collection is required. Results: We developed a computational method to locate regions of missing samples from the observed tree alone, without sequences from those samples. A machine learning model predicts which branches lead toward the missing region. Beam search then identifies three representative paths and estimates a candidate most recent common ancestor (MRCA) of the missing region for each path. We tested this framework on 5,000 simulated phylogenies where we controlled which tips were deleted. On an independent test set, the best candidate recovered an average of 89.9% of deleted tips, increasing to 90.7% when all three candidates were combined. Predicted and true MRCAs lay on the same ancestral-descendant lineage in 91.3% of cases. We further evaluated the approach on an empirical SARS-CoV-2 phylogeny with introduced missingness. By identifying potentially underrepresented lineages, this framework could help real-time identification of missing infections and improve outbreak response.
zh_abstract: 【动机】病原体系统发育树可用于监测病原体进化和检测新变异株，因其提供的信息有助于公共卫生决策和疫情应对。由于并非所有感染都被测序，某些病原体谱系可能在重建的系统发育树中缺失或代表性不足。识别这些空缺有助于确定哪些地方需要补充数据收集。【结果】我们开发了一种计算方法，仅根据观察到的树（无需这些样本的序列）来定位缺失样本所在区域。机器学习模型预测哪些分支通向缺失区域；随后通过束搜索（beam search）确定三条代表性路径，并为每条路径估计缺失区域的候选最近共同祖先（MRCA）。我们在5,000棵模拟系统发育树上检验了该框架，其中删除的末端节点是受控的。在独立测试集上，最佳候选平均恢复了89.9%的被删除末端节点，三个候选合并后提高到90.7%。在91.3%的情况下，预测的MRCA与真实MRCA位于同一祖先-后代谱系上。我们还在引入缺失的真实SARS-CoV-2系统发育树上进一步评估了该方法。通过识别可能代表性不足的谱系，该框架有助于实时识别缺失的感染并改善疫情应对。

title: An LLM-assisted Pipeline for Identifying ClinicalTrials.gov Registry Changes and Their Association with Primary Endpoint Positivity
zh_title: LLM辅助识别注册库变更及其与主要终点阳性的关联
summary: 构建结合确定性文本分析与LLM分类的流程，检测ClinicalTrials.gov记录版本变更，发现主要结局变更与试验阳性呈正相关（预印本）。
key_points: 自动检测RCT注册记录版本间变化
主要结局变更与阳性关联OR 1.91
臂与干预变更亦与阳性相关
reason: LLM用于注册库分析，应用较窄，预印本，增量档
abstract: Registration of randomized clinical trials (RCTs) in a public registry such as ClinicalTrials.gov should minimize the risk of reporting bias. However, records may be modified during a trial and the resulting discrepancies are not always apparent without a detailed examination of all version histories, a process that is cumbersome when performed manually. We developed an automated workflow to investigate whether specific changes to RCT registry entries are associated with primary endpoint positivity. Our pipeline extracts RCT records from ClinicalTrials.gov and systematically detects changes between successive versions using a combination of deterministic textual analysis and large language model (LLM)-assisted classification. We could show a positive association between trial positivity and changes to primary outcomes (OR 1.91; 95% CI 1.48-2.47) as well as to arms and interventions (OR 2.10; 95% CI 1.62-2.73). Associations were weaker when changes occurred exclusively before the primary completion date, pointing to the importance of timing in evaluating potentially consequential modifications to RCT design. Our automated pipeline can enable analysis of trial registration records at scale, facilitating the work of reviewers and meta-scientists to promote research integrity.
zh_abstract: 在 ClinicalTrials.gov 等公共注册平台上注册随机临床试验（RCT）应能将报告偏倚的风险降至最低。然而，记录可能在试验期间被修改，若不详细检查所有版本历史，由此产生的差异并不总是显而易见，而人工进行这一过程十分繁琐。我们开发了一种自动化工作流程，用于研究 RCT 注册条目的特定变更是否与主要终点结果为阳性相关。我们的流程从 ClinicalTrials.gov 提取 RCT 记录，并结合确定性文本分析与大语言模型（LLM）辅助分类，系统性地检测相邻版本之间的变更。我们发现试验结果为阳性与主要结局的变更（OR 1.91；95% CI 1.48-2.47）以及与试验组和干预措施的变更（OR 2.10；95% CI 1.62-2.73）之间均呈正相关。当变更仅发生在主要完成日期之前时，这种关联较弱，这提示在评估可能产生重要影响的 RCT 设计修改时，时间点十分重要。我们的自动化流程可以实现对试验注册记录的大规模分析，从而协助审稿人和元科学研究者的工作，促进研究诚信。

abstract: The curation of large cohort datasets for developing deep learning models demands annotating or editing over the AI-predicted labels. This study aimed to develop a simple, fast, semiautomated batch-annotation tool named MedImgAnnotator. The tool was created by integrating editing tools, image mask pair matching logic, preprocessing functions, object detection tool, and a plugin management system. Its performance was evaluated in terms of active annotation time and ease of use by the developer and 12 users using open-source MR and CT scans. Additionally, the tool had been used by the MICCAI 2026 CARE Challenge liver segmentation best performance winner to annotate liver masks from 6412 MRI volumes. The evaluation results showed that MedImgAnnotator
zh_abstract: 为开发深度学习模型而整理大型队列数据集，需要对 AI 预测的标签进行标注或编辑。然而，公开可用的标注工具耗时较长，因为它们涉及复杂的操作步骤，且不支持批处理。本研究旨在开发一种简单、快速、半自动的批量标注工具，名为 MedImgAnnotator。该工具通过整合编辑工具、图像-掩膜配对匹配逻辑、预处理功能、目标检测工具和插件管理系统而创建。开发者和 12 名用户使用开源 MR 和 CT 扫描，从有效标注时间和易用性方面评估了其性能。此外，MICCAI 2026 CARE 挑战赛肝脏分割最佳表现获奖者已使用该工具对 6412 个 MRI 容积的肝脏掩膜进行标注。评估结果显示，MedImgAnnotator（原文在此处截断）

title: QUTCC: Quantile Uncertainty Training and Conformal Calibration for Imaging Inverse Problems

summary: 提出基于带分位数嵌入U-Net的同步分位数回归方法，在保形校准中实现空间自适应缩放，以缩小图像不确定性区间。

abstract: While deep learning offers tremendous promise for scientific and medical imaging, any failures and hallucinations (predictions that do not coincide with reality) are hard to pinpoint and can have serious downstream consequences. Uncertainty estimation techniques, such as conformal prediction, can help by predicting statistically valid error bars for a model's prediction. However, popular conformal prediction methods were not designed for high-dimensional image-valued problems and do not take into account spatial correlations within an image during conformal calibration, resulting in larger-than-necessary uncertainty intervals. We propose a practical simultaneous quantile regression method that enables non-linear, spatially-adaptive scaling during conformal calibration. Our method, QUTCC uses a U-Net architecture with a quantile embedding to learn a full conditional quantile distribution
zh_abstract: 尽管深度学习在科学和医学成像领域前景广阔，但其任何失败和幻觉（与现实不符的预测）都难以确定，并可能造成严重的下游后果。不确定性估计技术（如共形预测）可通过为模型预测给出统计上有效的误差范围提供帮助。然而，常用的共形预测方法并非针对高维图像值问题而设计，在共形校准过程中也未考虑图像内的空间相关性，导致不确定性区间比必要的更大。我们提出一种实用的同时分位数回归方法，可在共形校准过程中实现非线性、空间自适应的缩放。我们的方法 QUTCC 采用带有分位数嵌入的 U-Net 架构，以学习完整的条件分位数分布

title: Physics-Aware Zero-Shot Learning for Low-Dose CT from a Single Sinogram

Zero-shot learning, which enables models to learn directly from individual images without external supervision, represents a compelling approach to mitigate distribution mismatches arising from variations in scanner hardware, imaging protocols, and patient demographics. However, most existing zero-shot approaches employ down-sampling operations that reduce spatial resolution and cause domain shifts, which become particularly evident when applied to raw sinogram data. Here, we propose a physics-aware zero-shot CT denoising framework to exploit the conjugate symmetry property intrinsic to CT sinograms. summary: 为单导联可穿戴心电提出深度水印框架，嵌入患者元数据，用冻结心律失常分类器约束诊断不变，并以汉明码保护载荷。

abstract: Wearable electrocardiogram (ECG) recordings pass through multiple networks and systems before automated interpretation, leaving patient metadata vulnerable to loss. Digital watermarking can embed this metadata in the signal, but conventional methods fail under time shifts, and high waveform similarity does not guarantee the same downstream diagnosis. We present \rev{ECGGuard}, a deep watermarking framework for single-lead ECG. A fully convolutional generator embeds the payload without signal quantization, a detector decodes the message frame by frame and checks for watermark presence, and during training a frozen arrhythmia classifier penalizes changes that would alter its predictions. Because high bit accuracy does not ensure whole-message recovery, the payload is protected by extended Hamming codes, \rev{a validation-selected channel ordering}, and soft-decision decoding. summary: 提出含100个日常决策（涵盖健康、金融等25个领域）的基准，测试五个模型在记忆用户偏好后是否省略警示等关键信息。

An answer with a warning removed can be true in every sentence, so fact-checks pass it, and an assistant with memory applies a preference stored once to later questions the user never had in mind. We introduce \bench{}, an Inspect benchmark of 100 everyday decisions across 25 domains in which only the assistant's memory of the user varies: the user states a belief, the model infers it from a remark, or a web page the user asked to summarise plants it. Testing five models, we find three effects. zh_abstract: 人们越来越多地通过 AI 助手来获取有关健康、金钱、法律和安全决策所需的信息，而助手遗漏的内容用户永远看不到。一个去掉了警告的回答可能每句话都是真实的，因此能通过事实核查；而具有记忆功能的助手会把曾经存储的某项偏好应用到用户从未想到过的后续问题上。我们提出 \bench{}，这是一个 Inspect 基准，涵盖 25 个领域的 100 个日常决策，其中只有助手对用户的记忆发生变化：用户陈述某种信念、模型从一句话中推断出该信念，或用户要求总结的网页植入该信念。在对五个模型的测试中，我们发现了三种效应。第一，在总结一个含有一行面向 AI 助手的指令的网页后，Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite 和 DeepSeek V4 Pro 在每个测试回合中都会把“偏好非常简短的回答且不想要警告”保存为用户偏好，并且分别有 93% 和

abstract: Diabetic retinopathy (DR) remains a leading cause of vision loss among working-age adults worldwide, making reliable severity grading clinically important. Despite strong performance, most deep models formulate DR grading as image-level classification and do not explicitly model clinically grounded evidence, such as lesion types and spatial relations. In this paper, we propose PARAGraph, a Pathology-Anatomy-Aware Hierarchical Graph framework for DR grading. PARAGraph represents each image as a three-level hierarchical graph with lesion-level nodes, intermediate category and region nodes, and global anatomical and semantic nodes. To incorporate medical priors into nodes, we construct an optic disc-fovea-anchored coordinate frame that provides a scale- and rotation-normalized retinal reference system. zh_abstract: 糖尿病视网膜病变（DR）仍是全球工作年龄成年人视力丧失的主要原因，因此可靠的严重程度分级具有重要的临床意义。尽管性能出色，大多数深度模型仍将 DR 分级表述为图像级分类，并未显式建模具有临床依据的证据，例如病变类型及其空间关系。本文提出 PARAGraph，一种用于 DR 分级的病理-解剖感知层次图（Pathology-Anatomy-Aware Hierarchical Graph）框架。PARAGraph 将每幅图像表示为三层层次图，包含病变级节点、中间的类别与区域节点，以及全局解剖与语义节点。为了将医学先验融入节点，我们构建了一个以视盘-黄斑中心凹为锚点的坐标系，提供经尺度和旋转归一化的视网膜参考系统。在该坐标系内，病变节点以类别、归一化面积和解剖位置进行编码

title: Radiative Gaussian Splatting for Efficient X-ray Novel View Synthesis
zh_title: 辐射高斯泼溅：高效X射线新视角合成
summary: 提出基于3D高斯泼溅的X-Gaussian方法，用于X射线新视角投影合成与CT体重建，针对NeRF训练慢、推理慢的问题（预印本）。

abstract: X-ray is widely applied for transmission imaging due to its stronger penetration than natural light. When rendering novel view X-ray projections, existing methods mainly based on NeRF suffer from long training time and slow inference speed. In this paper, we propose a 3D Gaussian splatting-based method, namely X-Gaussian, for X-ray 3D reconstruction. Firstly, we redesign a radiative Gaussian point cloud model inspired by the isotropic nature of X-ray imaging. Our model excludes the influence of view direction when learning to predict the radiation intensity of 3D points. Based on this model, we develop a Differentiable Radiative Rasterization (DRR) with CUDA implementation. Secondly, we formulate a principled Radiative Gaussian Volume Querying (RGVQ) method that defines a continuous attenuation field from the original radiative point attributes and enables direct CT volume reconstruction
zh_abstract: X 射线由于比自然光具有更强的穿透力，被广泛应用于透射成像。在渲染新视角 X 射线投影时，现有主要基于 NeRF 的方法存在训练时间长、推理速度慢的问题。本文提出一种基于 3D 高斯泼溅的 X 射线三维重建方法，称为 X-Gaussian。首先，受 X 射线成像各向同性特性的启发，我们重新设计了一种辐射高斯点云模型。该模型在学习预测三维点的辐射强度时排除了视角方向的影响。基于该模型，我们开发了采用 CUDA 实现的可微辐射光栅化（Differentiable Radiative Rasterization，DRR）。其次，我们提出一种有原则的辐射高斯体查询（Radiative Gaussian Volume Querying，RGVQ）方法，该方法根据原始辐射点属性定义连续的衰减场，并能够直接重建 CT 体数据

abstract: In recent years Plug-and-Play (PnP) methods have achieved state-of-the-art performance in inverse imaging problems by replacing proximal operators with denoisers. Based on the proximal gradient method, some theoretical results of PnP have appeared, where appropriate step size is crucial for convergence analysis. However, in practical applications, applying PnP methods with theoretically guaranteed step sizes is difficult, and these algorithms are limited to Gaussian noise. In this paper,from a perspective of split convex feasibility problems (SCFP), an adaptive PnP algorithm with Projected Landweber Operator (PnP-PLO) is proposed to address these issues. Numerical experiments on image deblurring, super-resolution, and compressed sensing MRI experiments illustrate that PnP-PLO with theoretical guarantees outperforms state-of-the-art methods such as RED and RED-PRO.
zh_abstract: 近年来，即插即用（Plug-and-Play，PnP）方法通过用去噪器替代近端算子，在图像逆问题中取得了最先进的性能。基于近端梯度法，已出现一些关于 PnP 的理论结果，其中合适的步长对收敛性分析至关重要。然而，在实际应用中，使用具有理论保证的步长来应用 PnP 方法较为困难，并且这些算法仅限于高斯噪声。本文从分裂凸可行性问题（split convex feasibility problems，SCFP）的角度，提出了一种带有投影 Landweber 算子的自适应 PnP 算法（PnP-PLO）以解决这些问题。在图像去模糊、超分辨率和压缩感知 MRI 上的数值实验表明，具有理论保证的 PnP-PLO 优于 RED 和 RED-PRO 等最先进的方法。

abstract: [Frontiers in public health] Generative artificial intelligence is entering clinical communication through patient messaging, health education, and conversational decision support. Its capacity to produce reassuring language can coexist with inaccurate advice, unclear responsibility, and culturally inappropriate explanations. This mini-review examines how Chinese medical humanism can inform the calibration of trust in these encounters. Targeted literature identification integrates studies of trust and perceived empathy, research on traditional Chinese medicine communication, and medical education evidence with normative scholarship. The evidence distinguishes perceived empathy from relational accountability and technical performance from demonstrated patient benefit. Chinese medical ideals of benevolence, sincerity, holistic attention, and contextual judgment offer resources for interpreting professional responsibilities, but their incorporation into artificial intelligence has not been shown to restore trust or improve health outcomes. We synthesize these insights into a proposed dual-verification approach: an epistemic track checks evidence, uncertainty, and safety, while a relational track checks patient understanding, cultural meaning, preferences, and access to human care. Their convergence supports accountable communication and allows unresolved concerns to trigger human review. Educational applications connect critical appraisal of generated responses with reflection on classical medical ethics. Evaluation should prioritize appropriate reliance, error recognition, patient agency, and equitable access rather than maximizing trust scores. This approach reframes humanistic integration as a set of responsibilities for clinicians and institutions, with its effectiveness remaining an empirical question.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in public health] 生成式人工智能正通过患者消息、健康教育和对话式决策支持进入临床沟通。其生成令人安心的语言的能力，可能与不准确的建议、责任不明以及文化上不恰当的解释并存。本迷你综述探讨中国医学人文精神如何为这些交互中信任的校准提供参考。通过有针对性的文献检索，整合了关于信任与感知共情的研究、中医沟通研究，以及医学教育证据和规范性学术论述。现有证据区分了感知共情与关系性问责，以及技术性能与已证实的患者获益。中国医学中仁爱、诚信、整体关注和因时因地判断的理念，为解读专业责任提供了资源，但将其融入人工智能能否恢复信任或改善健康结局尚未得到证实。我们将这些见解综合为一种拟议的双重验证方法：认知轨道核查证据、不确定性和安全性，关系轨道核查患者的理解、文化意义、偏好以及获得人工照护的途径。二者相互印证，有助于实现可问责的沟通，并使未解决的疑虑能够触发人工审核。教育方面的应用将对生成回答的批判性评估与对古典医学伦理的反思相结合。评价应优先考虑恰当依赖、错误识别、患者自主性和公平可及，而不是追求信任评分最大化。该方法将人文融入重新表述为临床医生和机构的一组责任，其有效性仍有待实证检验。
